ex.en: Do you subscribe to any magazines?
ex.zh: 你有訂閱什麼雜誌嗎？

ex.en: What newspaper do you subscribe to?
ex.zh: 你訂閱哪一份報紙？

ex.en: Starting next month, I'm not subscribing to a newspaper.
ex.zh: 從下個月開始，我不訂報紙了。

ex.en: Subscribe to our channel for more videos.
ex.zh: 訂閱我們的頻道，看更多影片。

subscribe.en: to pay regularly to receive a magazine or service

ex.en: The company uses sustainable materials in its products.
ex.zh: 這家公司在產品中使用永續材料。

ex.en: We need a more sustainable way of living.
ex.zh: 我們需要更永續的生活方式。

sustainable.en: able to continue for a long time without harming the environment

ex.en: All subscriptions must be paid before the end of this year.
ex.zh: 所有訂閱費都必須在今年底前繳清。

ex.en: The subscription service is available for a fixed monthly fee with a one-month free trial.
ex.zh: 這項訂閱服務採固定月費，並提供一個月免費試用。

ex.en: I cancelled my magazine subscription last month.
ex.zh: 我上個月取消了雜誌訂閱。

subscription.en: an agreement to pay regularly for a magazine or service, or the money paid

ex.en: Please go to the supermarket to buy some fruit.
ex.zh: 請你去超市買些水果回來。

ex.en: There is a big supermarket in my neighborhood.
ex.zh: 我家附近有一間大超市。

ex.en: It being Sunday, the supermarket was very crowded.
ex.zh: 因為是星期天，超市非常擁擠。

supermarket.en: a large shop that sells food and other goods for the home

ex.en: The deadline for submission is Friday.
ex.zh: 提交期限是星期五。

ex.en: We received over 200 submissions for the contest.
ex.zh: 我們收到兩百多件參賽作品。

submission.en: the act of giving something to someone for them to consider, or the thing given

ex.en: We have the alternative of death and submission.
ex.zh: 我們只能在死亡和屈服之間二選一。

ex.en: They were forced into submission.
ex.zh: 他們被迫屈服。

submission.en: the act of accepting that someone else has power over you

ex.en: She supervises a team of ten engineers.
ex.zh: 她管理一個由十位工程師組成的團隊。

ex.en: Children must be supervised at the pool.
ex.zh: 孩子在泳池時必須有人看管。

ex.en: Who will supervise the project while you're away?
ex.zh: 你不在的時候誰負責監督這個專案？

supervise.en: to watch people or work to make sure things are done correctly

ex.en: We booked a suite with an ocean view.
ex.zh: 我們訂了一間海景套房。

ex.en: The hotel upgraded us to a suite for free.
ex.zh: 飯店免費幫我們升級成套房。

suite.en: a set of connected rooms in a hotel

ex.en: Our office uses the Microsoft Office suite.
ex.zh: 我們辦公室使用 Microsoft Office 套裝軟體。

ex.en: This software suite includes design and editing tools.
ex.zh: 這套軟體套件包含設計和編輯工具。

suite.en: a group of computer programs sold together

ex.en: The magazine has over 10,000 subscribers.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌有超過一萬名訂戶。

ex.en: Our channel just reached one million subscribers.
ex.zh: 我們的頻道剛突破一百萬訂閱。

subscriber.en: a person who pays regularly for a magazine or service

ex.en: This carpet is superior to that one in quality.
ex.zh: 這塊地毯的品質比那塊好得多。

ex.en: He is superior to me in English.
ex.zh: 他的英文比我好。

ex.en: He is superior to his opponents in all respects.
ex.zh: 他在各方面都勝過對手。

superior.en: better or of higher quality than another

ex.en: Be respectful to your superiors, if you have any.
ex.zh: 如果你有上司，要尊重他們。

ex.en: You should report this problem to your superior.
ex.zh: 你應該把這個問題報告給你的上司。

superior.en: a person who has a higher position at work than you

ex.en: The company is located in the suburbs of Boston.
ex.zh: 這家公司位於波士頓的郊區。

ex.en: A car is a must for life in the suburbs.
ex.zh: 住在郊區的話，汽車是必需品。

ex.en: He lives in the suburbs of Tokyo.
ex.zh: 他住在東京郊區。

suburb.en: an area of homes on the edge of a large town

ex.en: We went surfing in Kenting last summer.
ex.zh: 我們去年夏天去墾丁衝浪。

ex.en: Do you know how to surf?
ex.zh: 你會衝浪嗎？

surf.en: to ride on ocean waves while standing on a board

ex.en: She spends way too much time surfing the web.
ex.zh: 她花太多時間上網了。

ex.en: I surfed the internet for hours last night.
ex.zh: 我昨晚上網上了好幾個小時。

surf.en: to look at different pages on the internet

ex.en: The lake was gleaming in the bright sunshine.
ex.zh: 湖面在燦爛的陽光下閃閃發亮。

ex.en: Let's sit outside and enjoy the sunshine.
ex.zh: 我們坐在外面曬曬太陽吧。

sunshine.en: the light and heat from the sun

ex.en: Subtract three from eight and you get five.
ex.zh: 八減三等於五。

ex.en: Subtract two from ten and you have eight.
ex.zh: 十減二等於八。

ex.en: Subtract the discount from the total price.
ex.zh: 從總價中扣掉折扣。

subtract.en: to take one number away from another

ex.en: Sales have increased substantially this year.
ex.zh: 今年銷售大幅成長。

ex.en: The new system substantially reduces costs.
ex.zh: 新系統大幅降低了成本。

ex.en: The two reports are substantially the same.
ex.zh: 這兩份報告大致相同。

ex.en: The plan remains substantially unchanged.
ex.zh: 計畫基本上沒有改變。

ex.en: They sued the government for damages.
ex.zh: 他們控告政府，要求損害賠償。

ex.en: The customer threatened to sue the company.
ex.zh: 那位顧客揚言要告這家公司。

ex.en: She sued her former employer for unfair dismissal.
ex.zh: 她控告前雇主不當解僱。

sue.en: to take someone to court to ask for money because they harmed you

ex.en: The hotel offers superb views of the ocean.
ex.zh: 這家飯店可以欣賞絕佳的海景。

ex.en: The food at the wedding was superb.
ex.zh: 婚宴上的菜色非常棒。

ex.en: The city should subsidize small businesses in industries with large overhead costs.
ex.zh: 市政府應該補助那些營運成本龐大產業中的小型企業。

ex.en: The government subsidizes public transportation.
ex.zh: 政府補貼大眾運輸。

ex.en: The company subsidizes employees' gym memberships.
ex.zh: 公司補助員工的健身房會費。

subsidize.en: to give money to help pay for something

ex.en: Did you notice any suspicious places?
ex.zh: 你有注意到任何可疑的地方嗎？

ex.en: This statement is actually kind of suspicious.
ex.zh: 這種說法其實有點可疑。

ex.en: Please report any suspicious packages to staff.
ex.zh: 如果發現可疑包裹，請通報工作人員。

suspicious.en: making you think that something is wrong or illegal

suspicious.zh: 懷疑的、起疑心的（be suspicious of）

ex.en: The police were suspicious of his movements.
ex.zh: 警方對他的行蹤起了疑心。

ex.en: The police are suspicious of my alibi.
ex.zh: 警方懷疑我的不在場證明。

ex.en: My manager was suspicious of the low price.
ex.zh: 我的經理對這麼低的價格感到懷疑。

suspicious.en: feeling that someone may have done something wrong

ex.en: Put on some sunscreen.
ex.zh: 擦點防曬乳吧。

ex.en: Don't forget to bring sunscreen to the beach.
ex.zh: 去海邊別忘了帶防曬乳。

sunscreen.en: a cream that protects your skin from the sun

ex.en: The company has subsidiaries in five countries.
ex.zh: 這家公司在五個國家設有子公司。

ex.en: She works for a subsidiary of a Japanese firm.
ex.zh: 她在一家日本公司的子公司上班。

subsidiary.en: a company that is owned by a larger company

ex.en: This is a subsidiary issue, so let's focus on the main one.
ex.zh: 這是次要問題，我們先專注在主要問題上。

ex.en: The department plays a subsidiary role.
ex.zh: 這個部門扮演輔助的角色。

ex.en: We had a sub today because our teacher was sick.
ex.zh: 老師生病了，所以今天有代課老師。

ex.en: The coach brought on a sub in the second half.
ex.zh: 教練在下半場換上一名替補球員。

sub.en: a person who takes the place of another, in a class or on a team

ex.en: Can I sub salad for fries?
ex.zh: 我可以把薯條換成沙拉嗎？

ex.en: Tom subbed for me at the meeting.
ex.zh: 湯姆代替我去開會。

sub.en: to use one thing in place of another

ex.en: I'll grab a turkey sub for lunch.
ex.zh: 我午餐要買個火雞肉潛艇堡。

ex.en: This shop makes the best subs in town.
ex.zh: 這家店的潛艇堡是全城最好吃的。

sub.en: a long sandwich filled with meat, cheese and vegetables

ex.en: The summit of Mt. Fuji was covered in snow.
ex.zh: 富士山頂覆蓋著白雪。

ex.en: Who first reached the summit of Mt. Everest?
ex.zh: 誰最先登上聖母峰頂？

ex.en: The air is thin at the summit.
ex.zh: 山頂的空氣很稀薄。

summit.en: the highest point of a mountain

ex.en: World leaders will meet at the summit next week.
ex.zh: 各國領袖下週將在高峰會上會面。

ex.en: The company hosted a summit on climate technology.
ex.zh: 公司主辦了一場氣候科技高峰會。

summit.en: an important meeting between leaders of countries

ex.en: The board has chosen a successor to the CEO.
ex.zh: 董事會已選出執行長的接班人。

ex.en: I will train my successor before I leave.
ex.zh: 我離職前會訓練我的接任者。

successor.en: a person who takes over a job or position from another

ex.en: Tom tried to suppress a smile.
ex.zh: 湯姆努力忍住不笑。

ex.en: Heathers help to suppress weeds in your garden.
ex.zh: 石楠有助於抑制花園裡的雜草。

ex.en: This medicine can suppress your appetite.
ex.zh: 這種藥會抑制食慾。

suppress.en: to stop yourself from showing a feeling

ex.en: Is France trying to suppress Algeria's development?
ex.zh: 法國是在試圖壓制阿爾及利亞的發展嗎？

ex.en: The company tried to suppress the bad news.
ex.zh: 公司試圖封鎖壞消息。

suppress.en: to stop something by force, or to keep information secret

ex.en: According to the newspaper, he committed suicide.
ex.zh: 據報導，他自殺了。

ex.en: The popular singer committed suicide.
ex.zh: 那位知名歌手自殺了。

suicide.en: the act of killing oneself on purpose

ex.en: Raising prices now would be commercial suicide.
ex.zh: 現在漲價等於是商業自殺。

ex.en: Quitting without a plan is career suicide.
ex.zh: 沒計畫就辭職等於斷送職涯。

suicide.en: an action that will certainly lead to your own failure

ex.en: The news confirmed my suspicions.
ex.zh: 這則消息證實了我的懷疑。

ex.en: My suspicions were unfounded.
ex.zh: 我的懷疑毫無根據。

ex.en: Suspicion is destructive of friendship.
ex.zh: 猜疑會破壞友誼。

suspicion.en: a feeling that something is wrong or someone is guilty

ex.en: He was under suspicion of being a spy.
ex.zh: 他被懷疑是間諜。

ex.en: He was arrested on suspicion of fraud.
ex.zh: 他因涉嫌詐欺被逮捕。

suspicion.en: the belief that someone may have done something illegal

ex.en: Sami had no choice but to surrender.
ex.zh: 薩米別無選擇，只能投降。

ex.en: I would rather die than surrender.
ex.zh: 我寧死也不投降。

ex.en: The garrison was forced to surrender.
ex.zh: 駐軍被迫投降。

surrender.en: to stop fighting and accept that you have lost

ex.en: Passengers must surrender their tickets at the gate.
ex.zh: 乘客必須在入口交出票券。

ex.en: He refused to surrender control of the company.
ex.zh: 他拒絕交出公司的控制權。

surrender.en: to give something up because you have to

ex.en: The restaurant is supposedly the best in town.
ex.zh: 據說這家餐廳是城裡最好的。

ex.en: This printer is supposedly easy to use, but I can't get it to work.
ex.zh: 這台印表機照理說很好用，但我就是弄不好。

ex.en: Tom is supposedly on vacation this week.
ex.zh: 湯姆這週應該是在休假。

supposedly.en: according to what people believe, though it may not be true

ex.en: The room is not sufficiently large for the meeting.
ex.zh: 這個房間不夠大，容納不了這場會議。

ex.en: Make sure the meat is sufficiently cooked.
ex.zh: 要確定肉有充分煮熟。

ex.en: Has the plan been sufficiently tested?
ex.zh: 這個方案經過充分測試了嗎？

sufficiently.en: to the amount that is needed

ex.en: New employees work under the supervision of a senior colleague.
ex.zh: 新進員工在資深同事的督導下工作。

ex.en: Children should not swim without supervision.
ex.zh: 小孩不應該在沒人看顧的情況下游泳。

supervision.en: the act of watching people or work to make sure things are done correctly

ex.en: Substitutions are not allowed on the set menu.
ex.zh: 套餐內容不能更換。

ex.en: The recipe allows the substitution of olive oil for butter.
ex.zh: 這道食譜可以用橄欖油代替奶油。

substitution.en: the act of using one person or thing in place of another

ex.en: I'm super hungry.
ex.zh: 我超餓的。

ex.en: I only buy super soft toilet paper.
ex.zh: 我只買超柔軟的衛生紙。

ex.en: Po-lin ran into his ex at the night market yesterday. It was super awkward.
ex.zh: 柏霖昨天在夜市遇到前女友，尷尬到不行。

ex.en: We had a super time at the party.
ex.zh: 我們在派對上玩得超開心。

ex.en: That's a super idea!
ex.zh: 那真是個超棒的點子！

ex.en: The subprime mortgage crisis began in 2007.
ex.zh: 次級房貸危機始於 2007 年。

ex.en: Subprime loans are risky for lenders.
ex.zh: 次級貸款對放款人來說風險很高。

subprime.en: describing loans given to people who may not be able to pay them back

ex.en: His writing is very subjective.
ex.zh: 他的文章寫得很主觀。

ex.en: Taste in music is very subjective.
ex.zh: 對音樂的喜好是很主觀的。

subjective.en: based on personal feelings rather than facts

ex.en: It rained five successive days.
ex.zh: 雨連續下了五天。

ex.en: The company has reported losses for three successive years.
ex.zh: 這家公司已連續三年虧損。

ex.en: Successive governments have failed to solve the problem.
ex.zh: 歷屆政府都沒能解決這個問題。

ex.en: We had a succession of problems with the new software.
ex.zh: 新軟體接二連三出問題。

ex.en: She won three titles in succession.
ex.zh: 她連續拿下三座冠軍。

succession.en: a number of things that happen one after another

ex.en: The board is discussing succession planning.
ex.zh: 董事會正在討論接班計畫。

ex.en: The CEO's succession was announced last week.
ex.zh: 執行長的接班人選上週公布了。

succession.en: the process of taking over a position from someone

subtle.zh: 細微的、微妙的、不明顯的

ex.en: There are subtle differences between the two pictures.
ex.zh: 這兩張圖片之間有細微的差異。

ex.en: She gave me a subtle hint.
ex.zh: 她給了我一個委婉的暗示。

ex.en: The changes to the logo are subtle.
ex.zh: 標誌的改變很細微。

subtle.en: small and delicate, and not easy to notice

ex.en: Please refer to subsection 3.2 of the contract.
ex.zh: 請參閱合約第 3.2 小節。

ex.en: Each chapter is divided into several subsections.
ex.zh: 每一章都分成幾個小節。

subsection.en: a smaller part of a section in a document

ex.en: The company is committed to sustainability.
ex.zh: 這家公司致力於永續經營。

ex.en: Sustainability is a key part of our business strategy.
ex.zh: 永續是我們商業策略的重要一環。

sustainability.en: the ability to continue for a long time without harming the environment

ex.en: She has five years of supervisory experience.
ex.zh: 她有五年的管理經驗。

ex.en: He was promoted to a supervisory role.
ex.zh: 他被升為管理職。

supervisory.en: relating to the job of watching and directing other workers

ex.en: Tom didn't notice the surveillance camera.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒有注意到監視器。

ex.en: The building is under 24-hour video surveillance.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓有二十四小時的錄影監控。

surveillance.en: the careful watching of a person or place, especially by police

ex.en: Why do you need to read such a book?
ex.zh: 你為什麼要讀這種書？

ex.en: Such a plan will give rise to many problems.
ex.zh: 這樣的計畫會引發很多問題。

such.zh: 如此、那麼（such a + 形容詞 + 名詞）

ex.en: I can't afford to buy such an expensive car.
ex.zh: 我買不起這麼貴的車。

ex.en: It was such a nice day.
ex.zh: 那天天氣真好。

such.en: used to make a describing word stronger

ex.en: We sell fruit such as apples and bananas.
ex.zh: 我們賣蘋果、香蕉等水果。

ex.en: Big cities such as Taipei are expensive to live in.
ex.zh: 像台北這樣的大城市生活費很高。

such.en: used to introduce examples of something

ex.en: I am not sure how to pronounce the word.
ex.zh: 我不太確定這個字怎麼發音。

ex.en: I was sure I had never seen her before.
ex.zh: 我確定我以前沒見過她。

ex.en: I am sure that he is an honest man.
ex.zh: 我確信他是個誠實的人。

ex.en: Sure, I'd be happy to help.
ex.zh: 當然，我很樂意幫忙。

ex.en: Sure, you can use my laptop.
ex.zh: 好啊，你可以用我的筆電。

sure.en: used to say yes or agree to something

ex.en: Please make sure the door is locked.
ex.zh: 請確認門有鎖好。

ex.en: Make sure you save your work.
ex.zh: 記得一定要存檔。

sure.en: to check that something is true or has been done

ex.en: Where do you suppose you'll spend your vacation?
ex.zh: 你想你會去哪裡度假？

ex.en: I could tell Tom the truth, I suppose.
ex.zh: 我想我可以告訴湯姆實話。

ex.en: I suppose you're right.
ex.zh: 我想你說得對。

suppose.en: to think that something is probably true

ex.en: I have done everything I was supposed to do.
ex.zh: 我該做的事都做了。

ex.en: Tom isn't doing what he's supposed to be doing.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒有在做他該做的事。

suppose.en: to be expected or required to do something

ex.en: Supposing you had one million yen, what would you do with it?
ex.zh: 假如你有一百萬日圓，你會拿來做什麼？

ex.en: Suppose the flight is canceled. What will we do?
ex.zh: 假設班機取消了，我們該怎麼辦？

suppose.en: to imagine that something is true

ex.en: To my surprise, there were no people in the village.
ex.zh: 令人意外的是，村子裡一個人也沒有。

ex.en: To my surprise, he easily came up with a plan.
ex.zh: 令我驚訝的是，他輕易就想出了一個計畫。

surprise.en: the feeling you have when something unexpected happens

surprise.zh: 使驚訝（be surprised 感到驚訝）

ex.en: I'm surprised that you don't know about their marriage.
ex.zh: 我很驚訝你竟然不知道他們結婚了。

ex.en: I'm surprised you agreed to have lunch with me.
ex.zh: 我很意外你願意和我一起吃午餐。

surprise.en: to make someone feel that something is unexpected

ex.en: Japan is full of surprises!
ex.zh: 日本處處充滿驚喜！

ex.en: We're planning a surprise party for Amy.
ex.zh: 我們正在為艾咪籌備驚喜派對。

ex.en: What a nice surprise!
ex.zh: 真是個驚喜！

ex.en: Honesty was the most important factor in his success.
ex.zh: 誠實是他成功最重要的因素。

ex.en: He was happy at the news of her success.
ex.zh: 聽到她成功的消息，他很高興。

ex.en: Please accept my sincere congratulations on your success today.
ex.zh: 對您今天的成功，請接受我最誠摯的祝賀。

success.en: the achieving of what you wanted to do

ex.en: Brazil supplies the world with coffee beans of quality.
ex.zh: 巴西向全世界供應優質咖啡豆。

ex.en: This dam supplies us with water and electricity.
ex.zh: 這座水壩為我們提供水和電。

ex.en: We have supplied the villagers with food.
ex.zh: 我們提供食物給村民。

supply.en: to give people something that they need

ex.en: The supply of fresh water is limited.
ex.zh: 淡水的供應有限。

ex.en: Prices rise when supply is low.
ex.zh: 供給不足時價格就會上漲。

supply.en: the amount of something that is available for use

ex.en: We need to order more office supplies.
ex.zh: 我們需要再訂一些辦公用品。

ex.en: Please bring your own art supplies.
ex.zh: 請自備美術用品。

supply.en: things that are needed for a particular purpose

ex.en: The number of people suffering from heart disease has increased.
ex.zh: 罹患心臟病的人數增加了。

ex.en: Do you suffer from diseases that require medication?
ex.zh: 您是否患有需要服藥的疾病？

ex.en: Many people are suffering from hunger around the world.
ex.zh: 世界上許多人正在挨餓。

suffer.en: to have an illness or a problem

ex.en: She looks happy, but deep down, she suffers.
ex.zh: 她看起來很幸福，但內心深處很痛苦。

ex.en: The company suffered heavy losses last year.
ex.zh: 公司去年遭受重大虧損。

suffer.en: to feel pain or sadness, or to experience something bad

ex.en: Their common aim was to make the project successful.
ex.zh: 他們共同的目標是讓這個專案成功。

ex.en: Tom seems to be a fairly successful businessman.
ex.zh: 湯姆看起來是個相當成功的商人。

ex.en: On the whole, the event was successful.
ex.zh: 整體而言，這場活動很成功。

ex.en: Jack suddenly stopped talking when Mary entered the room.
ex.zh: 瑪麗一走進房間，傑克就突然不說話了。

ex.en: The bus stopped suddenly in the middle of the street.
ex.zh: 公車突然在路中間停了下來。

ex.en: A boat suddenly appeared out of the mist.
ex.zh: 一艘船突然從霧中出現。

ex.en: Father always has the tailor make his suits.
ex.zh: 父親的西裝總是請這位裁縫訂做。

ex.en: Tom only wears a suit on special occasions.
ex.zh: 湯姆只在特殊場合穿西裝。

ex.en: You should wear a suit to the job interview.
ex.zh: 去面試應該穿西裝。

suit.en: a jacket and trousers or skirt made from the same cloth

ex.en: I don't think John is suited for the job.
ex.zh: 我不覺得約翰適合這份工作。

ex.en: This work is not suited to young girls.
ex.zh: 這份工作不適合年輕女孩。

ex.en: I'll see you whenever it suits you.
ex.zh: 你什麼時候方便，我們就什麼時候見面。

suit.en: to be convenient or right for someone

ex.en: The customer filed a suit against the company.
ex.zh: 那位顧客對公司提起訴訟。

ex.en: The company settled the suit out of court.
ex.zh: 公司在庭外和解了這起訴訟。

suit.en: a case in a court of law

ex.en: About one third of the earth's surface is land.
ex.zh: 地球表面大約三分之一是陸地。

ex.en: A light breeze stirred the surface of the lake.
ex.zh: 微風吹動湖面。

ex.en: The surface of the object is fairly rough.
ex.zh: 這個物體的表面相當粗糙。

surface.en: the outside or top part of something

ex.en: The fugitive surfaced in a small town fifty miles from here but then disappeared again.
ex.zh: 那名逃犯在離這裡五十英里的小鎮現身後，又消失了。

ex.en: New problems surfaced during the test.
ex.zh: 測試期間出現了新的問題。

surface.en: to come up to the top of water, or to appear after being hidden

ex.en: Your interpretation is based merely on the surface meaning.
ex.zh: 你的理解只是根據字面意思。

ex.en: The differences are only surface details.
ex.zh: 這些差異只是表面細節。

surface.en: relating to the outside part only, not what is deeper

ex.en: The garden was surrounded by a wooden fence.
ex.zh: 花園四周圍著木柵欄。

ex.en: He was surrounded by a throng of reporters.
ex.zh: 他被一大群記者包圍。

ex.en: Japan is a country surrounded by the sea on all sides.
ex.zh: 日本是四面環海的國家。

surround.en: to be or go all around something

ex.en: The surrounding area was very quiet.
ex.zh: 周圍地區非常安靜。

ex.en: I've been to the area surrounding Shanghai.
ex.zh: 我去過上海周邊地區。

surround.en: being in the area close around a place

ex.en: Only 3 out of the 98 passengers survived.
ex.zh: 98 名乘客中只有 3 人生還。

ex.en: If it weren't for water, humans wouldn't survive.
ex.zh: 沒有水的話，人類就活不下去。

ex.en: Only a few old buildings survived the earthquake.
ex.zh: 只有少數老建築在地震中倖存。

survive.en: to continue to live after an accident or illness

ex.en: Small businesses will have to tighten their belts to survive.
ex.zh: 小企業得勒緊褲帶才能撐下去。

ex.en: I can't survive without air conditioning in the summer.
ex.zh: 夏天沒有冷氣我活不下去。

ex.en: The company survived the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 這家公司撐過了金融危機。

survive.en: to manage to continue in a difficult situation

ex.en: Tom refused to even listen to my suggestions.
ex.zh: 湯姆連聽都不肯聽我的建議。

ex.en: Her suggestion seems to have been turned down.
ex.zh: 她的建議好像被否決了。

ex.en: Why don't you give me a few suggestions?
ex.zh: 你何不給我一些建議？

suggestion.en: an idea that you offer for someone to consider

ex.en: The sun rises earlier in summer than in winter.
ex.zh: 太陽在夏天比冬天早升起。

ex.en: Cover your head when you are in the sun.
ex.zh: 在大太陽底下要把頭遮住。

ex.en: We should sometimes expose our bodies to the sun.
ex.zh: 我們偶爾應該出去曬曬太陽。

sun.en: the star that gives light and heat to the Earth, or its light

ex.en: She had only a small sum of money.
ex.zh: 她當時只有一點點錢。

ex.en: The sum came to over 20,000 yen.
ex.zh: 總金額超過了兩萬日圓。

ex.en: The company paid a large sum for the land.
ex.zh: 公司花了一大筆錢買下那塊地。

ex.en: The sum of 5 and 3 is 8.
ex.zh: 五加三的和是八。

ex.en: The sum of two plus three plus four is nine.
ex.zh: 二加三加四的總和是九。

sum.en: the number you get when you add numbers together

ex.en: His thesis summed up the new achievements made in computers, artificial satellites and rockets.
ex.zh: 他的論文總結了電腦、人造衛星和火箭方面的新成就。

ex.en: To sum up, the project was a success.
ex.zh: 總而言之，這個專案很成功。

sum.en: to give the main points of something in a short form

ex.en: He suspects me of telling a lie.
ex.zh: 他懷疑我說謊。

ex.en: I suspect Tom knows what he's supposed to do.
ex.zh: 我猜湯姆知道自己該做什麼。

ex.en: I suspect that the printer is broken again.
ex.zh: 我猜印表機又壞了。

suspect.en: to think that something is probably true or that someone did something wrong

ex.en: The police arrested two suspects.
ex.zh: 警方逮捕了兩名嫌犯。

ex.en: The suspect was seen leaving the bank.
ex.zh: 有人看到嫌犯離開銀行。

suspect.en: a person who the police think may have committed a crime

ex.en: You must work hard if you want to succeed.
ex.zh: 如果你想成功，就必須努力。

ex.en: She succeeded in getting him to tell the truth.
ex.zh: 她成功讓他說出了真相。

ex.en: We believe he will succeed, for he has talent.
ex.zh: 他很有才能，我們相信他會成功。

succeed.en: to achieve what you wanted to do

ex.en: She will succeed Mr. Lin as CEO next year.
ex.zh: 她明年將接替林先生擔任執行長。

ex.en: Who succeeded him as manager?
ex.zh: 誰接替他當經理？

succeed.en: to take over a job or position from someone

ex.en: These scissors are suitable for left and right-handed people.
ex.zh: 這把剪刀左右手都適用。

ex.en: Fill in the blanks with suitable words.
ex.zh: 請在空格中填入適當的字詞。

ex.en: We are still looking for a suitable venue for the event.
ex.zh: 我們還在找適合辦活動的場地。

suitable.en: right or acceptable for a particular purpose

surely.zh: 一定、想必；（表示驚訝）難道

ex.en: Among the five of us, he's surely the one who can speak the most languages.
ex.zh: 我們五個人之中，他一定是會說最多種語言的。

ex.en: Surely you don't believe him?
ex.zh: 你該不會相信他吧？

surely.en: used when you feel certain, or when you are surprised

surely.zh: slowly but surely：緩慢但穩定地

ex.en: Slowly but surely, the business is growing.
ex.zh: 生意雖然成長得慢，但很穩定。

ex.en: My English is improving slowly but surely.
ex.zh: 我的英文雖然進步得慢，但一步步在進步。

surely.en: making progress in small steps that do not stop

ex.en: The company made a substantial profit this year.
ex.zh: 公司今年獲利可觀。

ex.en: We received a substantial number of complaints.
ex.zh: 我們收到了大量的客訴。

ex.en: There is no substantial difference between the two plans.
ex.zh: 這兩個計畫沒有實質上的差異。

ex.en: The report contains substantial changes.
ex.zh: 這份報告有重大的修改。

ex.en: We have sufficient evidence to prove this hypothesis.
ex.zh: 我們有充分的證據證明這個假設。

ex.en: The room lighting is sufficient.
ex.zh: 房間的光線很充足。

ex.en: I haven't yet collected sufficient materials to write a book.
ex.zh: 我還沒蒐集到足夠的資料來寫一本書。

ex.en: There was a sudden change in her tone.
ex.zh: 她的語氣突然變了。

ex.en: I was surprised at the news of his sudden death.
ex.zh: 聽到他猝逝的消息，我很驚訝。

ex.en: All of a sudden, she began to laugh.
ex.zh: 她突然笑了起來。

ex.en: All of a sudden the sky became dark.
ex.zh: 天空突然暗了下來。

supporter.zh: 支持者；（球隊的）支持者、球迷

ex.en: We are looking for supporters.
ex.zh: 我們正在尋找支持者。

ex.en: She is a strong supporter of the new policy.
ex.zh: 她大力支持這項新政策。

ex.en: Thousands of supporters attended the match.
ex.zh: 數千名球迷到場觀賽。

supporter.en: a person who agrees with and helps a person, group or team

ex.en: The substance is light enough to float on the water.
ex.zh: 這種物質很輕，可以浮在水面上。

ex.en: The mixture of these substances is dangerous.
ex.zh: 把這些物質混在一起很危險。

ex.en: Water and ice are the same substance in different forms.
ex.zh: 水和冰是同一種物質的不同形態。

substance.en: a type of solid, liquid or gas

ex.en: The speech was long but lacked substance.
ex.zh: 這場演講很長，但缺乏實質內容。

ex.en: There is no substance to these rumors.
ex.zh: 這些傳言毫無根據。

substance.en: the real meaning or importance of something

ex.en: I am not used to drinking coffee without sugar.
ex.zh: 我不習慣喝不加糖的咖啡。

ex.en: How much sugar should I put in your coffee?
ex.zh: 你的咖啡要加多少糖？

ex.en: We need flour, sugar and eggs to make this cake.
ex.zh: 做這個蛋糕需要麵粉、砂糖和雞蛋。

sugar.en: a sweet white or brown food added to drinks and cakes

ex.en: Subsequent meetings will be held online.
ex.zh: 之後的會議將在線上舉行。

ex.en: The problem was fixed in a subsequent update.
ex.zh: 這個問題在後續的更新中修正了。

ex.en: The company cannot sustain such rapid growth.
ex.zh: 公司無法維持如此快速的成長。

ex.en: We need more funding to sustain the project.
ex.zh: 我們需要更多資金來維持這個專案。

sustain.en: to make something continue for a period of time

ex.en: We sustained significant losses.
ex.zh: 我們蒙受了重大損失。

ex.en: Tom sustained serious burns and had to go to the hospital.
ex.zh: 湯姆嚴重燒傷，必須去醫院。

sustain.en: to experience damage, loss or injury

ex.en: I developed a tumor in my stomach, which required surgery.
ex.zh: 我胃裡長了腫瘤，必須動手術。

ex.en: Do I need surgery?
ex.zh: 我需要做手術嗎？

ex.en: Cosmetic surgery is not covered by most insurance plans.
ex.zh: 大部分保險方案都不給付整形手術。

surgery.en: medical treatment in which a doctor cuts into the body

ex.en: Air pollution will be a threat to our survival.
ex.zh: 空氣汙染將會威脅我們的生存。

ex.en: Food, clothing and shelter are the foundations of survival.
ex.zh: 衣食住是生存的基礎。

ex.en: This medicine will increase the survival rate of the patients.
ex.zh: 這種藥會提高病人的存活率。

survival.en: the state of continuing to live or exist

ex.en: She successfully got him to tell the truth.
ex.zh: 她成功讓他說出了實話。

ex.en: He was extremely happy at having successfully solved the problem.
ex.zh: 他成功解決了這個問題，非常高興。

ex.en: Few governments can manage the economy successfully.
ex.zh: 能成功管理好經濟的政府不多。

successfully.en: in a way that achieves what was wanted

ex.en: The test was surprisingly easy.
ex.zh: 這次考試出乎意料地簡單。

ex.en: Surprisingly, nobody complained about the price.
ex.zh: 令人意外的是，沒有人抱怨價格。

ex.en: The hotel was surprisingly cheap.
ex.zh: 這家飯店意外地便宜。

surprisingly.en: in a way that is unexpected

substitute.zh: 代替品；代替者（如代課老師、替補）

ex.en: There is no substitute for hard work.
ex.zh: 努力是無可取代的。

ex.en: Our teacher was sick, so we had a substitute today.
ex.zh: 我們老師生病了，所以今天有代課老師。

substitute.en: a person or thing that takes the place of another

ex.en: She substituted margarine for butter.
ex.zh: 她用人造奶油代替奶油。

ex.en: He substituted for his father.
ex.zh: 他接替了他父親的位置。

ex.en: You can substitute honey for sugar in this recipe.
ex.zh: 這道食譜可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

substitute.en: to use one person or thing in place of another

ex.en: From now on, you should exercise regularly. I bought some health supplements for you to try.
ex.zh: 以後要經常運動。我買了一些保健食品給你試試看。

ex.en: Many people take vitamin supplements every day.
ex.zh: 很多人每天吃維他命補充品。

supplement.en: something taken in addition to food to give the body more vitamins

ex.en: He supplements his income by teaching English at night.
ex.zh: 他晚上教英文來貼補收入。

ex.en: You can supplement your diet with fruit and nuts.
ex.zh: 你可以用水果和堅果來補充飲食。

supplement.en: to add something extra to make an amount larger

ex.en: The newspaper publishes a travel supplement on Sundays.
ex.zh: 這份報紙每週日出旅遊特刊。

ex.en: See the supplement at the end of the report for details.
ex.zh: 詳細內容請見報告末尾的附錄。

supplement.en: an extra section added to a newspaper or book

ex.en: Summarize the contents in 60 English words.
ex.zh: 請用六十個英文字摘要內容。

ex.en: Could you summarize the main points of the meeting?
ex.zh: 你能總結一下會議重點嗎？

ex.en: To summarize, sales rose by ten percent this year.
ex.zh: 總結來說，今年銷售額成長了一成。

summarize.en: to give the main points of something in a short form

ex.en: The meeting was subsequently canceled.
ex.zh: 那場會議後來被取消了。

ex.en: He joined the company in 2015 and subsequently became a manager.
ex.zh: 他 2015 年進公司，後來升為經理。

ex.en: Suspend the game.
ex.zh: 暫停比賽。

ex.en: The airline suspended all flights because of the typhoon.
ex.zh: 航空公司因颱風暫停所有航班。

ex.en: Production was suspended for two weeks.
ex.zh: 生產暫停了兩週。

suspend.en: to stop something for a period of time

ex.en: He was suspended from school for a week.
ex.zh: 他被停學一週。

ex.en: The employee was suspended without pay.
ex.zh: 那名員工被無薪停職。

suspend.en: to send someone away from their job or school as a punishment

ex.en: The lamp was suspended from the branch of a tree.
ex.zh: 燈掛在樹枝上。

ex.en: The earth is just a sphere suspended in space.
ex.zh: 地球只是一個懸浮在太空中的球體。

suspend.en: to hang something from a high place

ex.en: Only a small subset of users reported the bug.
ex.zh: 只有一小部分使用者回報了這個錯誤。

ex.en: This data is a subset of the full survey.
ex.zh: 這些資料是完整調查的一部分。

subset.en: a smaller group of things taken from a larger group

ex.en: The chips are built on a silicon substrate.
ex.zh: 這些晶片是做在矽基板上的。

ex.en: Mushrooms grow on a substrate of straw.
ex.zh: 蘑菇長在稻草做成的基質上。

substrate.en: a base layer that other things grow or are built on

ex.en: My father is an expert surgeon.
ex.zh: 我爸爸是一位技術精湛的外科醫生。

ex.en: He's an excellent brain surgeon.
ex.zh: 他是一位優秀的腦外科醫生。

ex.en: The surgeon explained the operation to the patient.
ex.zh: 外科醫生向病人說明手術內容。

surgeon.en: a doctor who performs medical operations

ex.en: The patient needs surgical treatment.
ex.zh: 病人需要手術治療。

ex.en: Doctors wear surgical masks during operations.
ex.zh: 醫生在手術時戴外科口罩。

ex.en: She was susceptible to colds.
ex.zh: 她很容易感冒。

ex.en: Older computers are more susceptible to viruses.
ex.zh: 舊電腦比較容易中毒。

susceptible.en: likely to be affected by something, especially an illness

ex.en: The embassy is located next to the Supreme Court.
ex.zh: 大使館就在最高法院旁邊。

ex.en: Customer satisfaction is of supreme importance to us.
ex.zh: 顧客滿意對我們來說是最重要的。

ex.en: The superintendent of schools visited our class today.
ex.zh: 教育局長今天來參觀我們班。

ex.en: The site superintendent checks the work every morning.
ex.zh: 工地主任每天早上檢查工程進度。

superintendent.en: a person who is in charge of an organization or area of work

ex.en: Call the superintendent if the heater stops working.
ex.zh: 暖氣壞了的話，請打給大樓管理員。

ex.en: The building superintendent fixed our leaking sink.
ex.zh: 大樓管理員修好了我們漏水的水槽。

superintendent.en: a person who looks after a large building, especially in the United States

ex.en: The submarine stayed underwater for weeks.
ex.zh: 那艘潛水艇在水下待了好幾週。

ex.en: You can visit an old submarine at the museum.
ex.zh: 你可以在博物館參觀一艘舊潛水艇。

submarine.en: a ship that can travel under water

ex.en: The submarine cable connects the island to the internet.
ex.zh: 這條海底電纜讓這座島連上網路。

ex.en: Scientists study submarine volcanoes.
ex.zh: 科學家研究海底火山。

submarine.en: existing or used under the sea

ex.en: I suggested that we should stay there another day.
ex.zh: 我提議我們在那裡再待一天。

ex.en: I suggest you turn around and go back home.
ex.zh: 我建議你轉身回家。

ex.en: I suggested that we should go to the movies.
ex.zh: 我提議我們應該去看電影。

suggest.en: to offer an idea for someone to consider

ex.en: Are you suggesting that I am too young?
ex.zh: 您是在暗示我太年輕嗎？

ex.en: His accent suggests he is a foreigner.
ex.zh: 他的口音顯示他是外國人。

suggest.en: to show or hint that something may be true

ex.en: It all depends on whether they will support us.
ex.zh: 這一切都要看他們支不支持我們。

ex.en: My family has always supported my decisions.
ex.zh: 我的家人一直都支持我的決定。

support.en: to agree with and help someone or something

ex.en: I worked hard in order to support my family.
ex.zh: 我努力工作養家。

ex.en: She supports her parents with her salary.
ex.zh: 她用自己的薪水奉養父母。

support.en: to provide the money someone needs to live

ex.en: I'd like a phone that supports fast charging.
ex.zh: 我想要支援快充的手機。

ex.en: Subscribers can play across phones, tablets, and computers, with certain games supporting multiplayer access and cloud sync.
ex.zh: 訂閱後可以在手機、平板和電腦上遊玩，部分遊戲支援多人連線和雲端同步。

support.en: to be able to work with a certain feature or system

ex.en: The steak was tender and succulent.
ex.zh: 牛排又嫩又多汁。

ex.en: These peaches are sweet and succulent.
ex.zh: 這些水蜜桃又甜又多汁。

succulent.en: full of juice and tasting good

ex.en: She keeps several succulents on her desk.
ex.zh: 她桌上放了好幾盆多肉植物。

ex.en: Succulents don't need much water.
ex.zh: 多肉植物不太需要澆水。

succulent.en: a plant with thick leaves that store water

ex.en: A warm, sunny day is ideal for a picnic.
ex.zh: 溫暖的晴天最適合野餐。

ex.en: I also hope for sunny weather at the weekend.
ex.zh: 我也希望週末是晴天。

ex.en: Tomorrow will be a sunny day, and very hot.
ex.zh: 明天是晴天，而且會很熱。

sunny.en: bright with light from the sun

ex.en: She has a sunny personality.
ex.zh: 她個性很開朗。

ex.en: He always greets us with a sunny smile.
ex.zh: 他總是帶著燦爛的笑容跟我們打招呼。

ex.en: Every year, the summers get hotter and the winters get colder.
ex.zh: 夏天一年比一年熱，冬天一年比一年冷。

ex.en: My friend George is coming to Japan this summer.
ex.zh: 我朋友George今年夏天要來日本。

ex.en: Taipei's summers are extremely hot and humid!
ex.zh: 台北的夏天又熱又潮濕！

summer.en: the warmest season of the year, after spring

ex.en: I'm surprised that you don't know about their marriage.
ex.zh: 我很驚訝，你竟然不知道他們結婚了。

ex.en: We were all surprised when Tom won the race.
ex.zh: 當湯姆贏了比賽，我們都很驚訝。

ex.en: The whole neighborhood was surprised at the news.
ex.zh: 整個小區對這個訊息很驚訝。

ex.en: The real answer is surprising.
ex.zh: 真正的答案令人驚訝。

ex.en: This is surprising.
ex.zh: 這是令人吃驚的。

ex.en: I've something interesting to tell you that you might find surprising.
ex.zh: 告訴你個好玩的事，能驚你一下。

surprising.en: unexpected and causing a feeling of wonder

ex.en: He has only a superficial knowledge of Japanese.
ex.zh: 他對日文只是略懂皮毛。

ex.en: You have to acquire real skills, not just superficial knowledge.
ex.zh: 你要學的是實實在在的技能，而不單是表面的知識。

ex.en: The wound is only superficial and will heal soon.
ex.zh: 傷口只是表皮傷，很快就會癒合。

superficial.en: not deep or thorough, looking only at the outside

ex.en: Superstitions derive from the inability of men to acknowledge that coincidences are merely coincidences.
ex.zh: 迷信之所以存在，是因為人無法接受巧合只是巧合而已。

ex.en: Such a ridiculous superstition no longer exists.
ex.zh: 這種荒謬的迷信已不復存在了。

ex.en: It's an old superstition that breaking a mirror brings bad luck.
ex.zh: 打破鏡子會帶來厄運是個古老的迷信。

superstition.en: a belief in magic or luck that has no scientific reason

ex.en: Some athletes are superstitious and wear the same socks every game.
ex.zh: 有些運動員很迷信，每場比賽都穿同一雙襪子。

ex.en: My grandmother is superstitious about the number four.
ex.zh: 我奶奶對數字四很迷信。

superstitious.en: believing in magic or luck that has no scientific reason

ex.en: Keep plastic bags away from babies, or they could suffocate.
ex.zh: 塑膠袋要遠離嬰兒，否則他們可能會窒息。

ex.en: The thick smoke nearly suffocated the firefighters.
ex.zh: 濃煙差點讓消防員窒息。

suffocate.en: to die or make someone die because of not being able to breathe

ex.en: The police quickly subdued the angry man.
ex.zh: 警察很快就制服了那個憤怒的男子。

ex.en: The army was sent to subdue the rebels.
ex.zh: 軍隊被派去鎮壓叛軍。

subdue.en: to bring a person under control by force

ex.en: She tried to subdue her anger during the meeting.
ex.zh: 她在會議上努力克制自己的怒氣。

ex.en: He took a deep breath to subdue his nerves before the speech.
ex.zh: 演講前他深吸一口氣，壓下緊張的情緒。

subdue.en: to control a feeling and stop yourself showing it

ex.en: The manager summoned all the staff to an urgent meeting.
ex.zh: 經理召集全體員工開緊急會議。

ex.en: The principal summoned the two boys to her office.
ex.zh: 校長把那兩個男孩叫到她的辦公室。

summon.en: to order someone to come to you

ex.en: He finally summoned the courage to ask her out.
ex.zh: 他終於鼓起勇氣約她出去。

ex.en: She summoned all her strength to finish the race.
ex.zh: 她使出全身力氣跑完比賽。

summon.en: to gather your courage or strength to do something

ex.en: He soon got used to the new surroundings.
ex.zh: 他很快就適應了新的環境。

ex.en: He quickly accustomed himself to his new surroundings.
ex.zh: 他很快就適應了新環境。

ex.en: The rescuers searched the surroundings in hopes of finding the child.
ex.zh: 救援人員仔細搜尋了周遭一帶，希望找到那個孩子。

surroundings.en: the place and things around you

ex.en: The team showed its superiority by winning every match this season.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍本季每場都贏，展現了壓倒性的優勢。

ex.en: The new phone's superiority in battery life is clear.
ex.zh: 這款新手機在電池續航力上的優勢很明顯。

superiority.en: the state of being better or stronger than others

ex.en: He speaks to his coworkers with an air of superiority.
ex.zh: 他跟同事說話時總帶著一股優越感。

ex.en: Her sense of superiority made it hard for her to make friends.
ex.zh: 她的優越感讓她很難交到朋友。

superiority.en: a proud feeling that you are better than other people

ex.en: She turned down the subsidy that I offered.
ex.zh: 她拒絕了我提供的補助。

ex.en: Farmers receive government subsidies.
ex.zh: 農民會領取政府補貼。

subsidy.en: money given by a government to help pay for something

ex.en: The builder hired a subcontractor for the electrical work.
ex.zh: 營造商把電力工程轉包給下包廠商。

ex.en: Subcontractors must follow our safety rules.
ex.zh: 下包廠商必須遵守我們的安全規定。

subcontractor.en: a company that does part of a job for another company

ex.en: A recent survey shows that the number of smokers is decreasing.
ex.zh: 最近的一項調查顯示吸菸的人數減少了。

ex.en: According to the latest survey, 99% of employees want a free iPad.
ex.zh: 根據最新調查，99% 的員工想要一台免費的 iPad。

ex.en: The results of the Chinese Academy of Sciences' survey are like this.
ex.zh: 中國科學院的調查結果是這樣的。

survey.en: a set of questions asked to many people to find out what they think

ex.en: We surveyed 1,000 customers about our service.
ex.zh: 我們針對服務品質調查了一千位顧客。

ex.en: Engineers surveyed the land before building the road.
ex.zh: 工程師在開路前先測量了土地。

survey.en: to ask many people questions, or to measure an area of land

ex.en: Edit your work better before you submit it, it's sloppy.
ex.zh: 交出去之前請好好檢查，這裡很粗糙。

ex.en: Your order has been submitted.
ex.zh: 您的訂單已送出。

ex.en: The due date for submitting the application is this Friday.
ex.zh: 申請截止日是這個星期五。

submit.en: to give something to someone for them to consider

ex.en: He submits to authority.
ex.zh: 他屈服於權威。

ex.en: They refused to submit to the new rules.
ex.zh: 他們拒絕服從新規定。

submit.en: to accept that someone else has power over you

ex.en: There is an urgent need for medical supplies.
ex.zh: 現在急需醫療用品。

ex.en: There's an urgent need for medical supplies.
ex.zh: 醫療用品嚴重不足。

ex.en: We're running out of office supplies.
ex.zh: 我們的辦公用品快用完了。

supplies.en: things that are needed for a particular purpose

ex.en: Brazil supplies the world with coffee beans of quality.
ex.zh: 巴西供應全世界優質的咖啡豆。

ex.en: This dam supplies us with water and electricity.
ex.zh: 這座水壩供應我們用水和電力。

ex.en: This school supplies textbooks to its students.
ex.zh: 這所學校為學生提供教科書。

supplies.en: to give people something that they need

ex.en: The country has a trade surplus with Europe.
ex.zh: 這個國家對歐洲有貿易順差。

ex.en: There is a surplus of teachers in some areas.
ex.zh: 有些地區的教師人數過剩。

surplus.en: an amount that is more than what is needed

ex.en: We donated the surplus food to a shelter.
ex.zh: 我們把多餘的食物捐給了收容所。

ex.en: The factory sold its surplus equipment.
ex.zh: 工廠把多餘的設備賣掉了。

ex.en: The policy allows suspension during an investigation.
ex.zh: 這項政策允許在調查期間暫時停職。

ex.en: The service suspension will last two hours.
ex.zh: 服務將暫停兩小時。

suspension.en: the act of stopping something or sending someone away for a time

ex.en: We want to develop a new supply chain with a supplier from Algeria.
ex.zh: 我們想和阿爾及利亞的供應商建立新的供應鏈。

ex.en: The storm disrupted the company's supply chain.
ex.zh: 暴風雨打亂了公司的供應鏈。

supply chain.en: the series of steps by which goods move from makers to buyers

ex.en: A fuel surcharge will apply to all deliveries.
ex.zh: 所有配送都會收取燃料附加費。

ex.en: The airline added a surcharge for oversized cargo.
ex.zh: 航空公司對超大型貨物加收附加費。

surcharge.en: an extra amount of money added to the normal price

ex.en: The surveyor marked the boundaries of the site.
ex.zh: 測量員標出了工地的界線。

ex.en: A surveyor inspected the land before construction began.
ex.zh: 施工開始前，測量師檢查了這塊土地。

surveyor.en: a person whose job is to measure land and record its borders and features

ex.en: The tenant asked permission to sublet the apartment for the summer.
ex.zh: 房客詢問是否可以在夏季轉租公寓。

ex.en: You cannot sublet the office without written approval.
ex.zh: 未經書面核准，不得轉租辦公室。

sublet.en: to rent out a place that you are yourself renting from someone else

ex.en: The firm opened a suburban branch to serve local families.
ex.zh: 公司在郊區設立分店，服務當地家庭。

ex.en: Suburban housing is often farther from major transit lines.
ex.zh: 郊區住宅通常離主要大眾運輸路線較遠。

suburban.en: relating to an area of homes on the edge of a large city

ex.en: Will you please help me carry this suitcase?
ex.zh: 你能幫我拿這個行李箱嗎？

ex.en: What's the weight of your suitcase?
ex.zh: 你的行李箱有多重？

ex.en: I put my suitcase in the trunk.
ex.zh: 我把行李箱放進後車廂了。

suitcase.en: a large case with a handle that you use to carry clothes when you travel

ex.en: It is cheap to take the subway in Beijing.
ex.zh: 在北京搭地鐵很便宜。

ex.en: Excuse me, which subway line is to the city centre?
ex.zh: 不好意思，請問哪條地鐵線到市中心？

ex.en: Dad takes the 7 a.m. subway to work.
ex.zh: 爸爸搭早上 7 點的地鐵去上班。

subway.en: an underground railway system in a city

ex.en: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來職能治療的需求大幅增加。

ex.en: Due to the rainstorm, the river water surged over the river banks.
ex.zh: 暴雨讓河水暴漲，漫過了河岸。

surge.en: to rise quickly and strongly in amount or level

ex.en: There was a surge in demand for masks.
ex.zh: 口罩需求激增。

ex.en: We expect a surge of visitors during the holidays.
ex.zh: 我們預期假期會湧入大量遊客。

surge.en: a sudden large rise in amount or level

ex.en: The following is a summary of the President's speech.
ex.zh: 以下是總統演講的摘要。

ex.en: Please write a short summary of the meeting.
ex.zh: 請寫一份簡短的會議摘要。

summary.en: a short account that gives only the main points of something

ex.en: We want to develop a new supply chain with a supplier from Algeria.
ex.zh: 我們想和一家阿爾及利亞的供應商建立新的供應鏈。

ex.en: We are looking for a cheaper supplier.
ex.zh: 我們正在找更便宜的供應商。

supplier.en: a person or company that provides goods that others need

ex.en: I need to ask my supervisor before I can approve this.
ex.zh: 我得先問過主管才能核准這件事。

ex.en: Her supervisor praised her for finishing the project early.
ex.zh: 她的主管稱讚她提早完成了專案。

supervisor.en: a person who watches over workers and checks that their work is done properly

ex.en: A good manager listens to his subordinates.
ex.zh: 好主管會傾聽部屬的意見。

ex.en: She treats her subordinates with respect.
ex.zh: 她很尊重她的下屬。

subordinate.en: a person who has a lower position than another person at work

ex.en: Personal interests should be subordinate to the team's goals.
ex.zh: 個人利益應該放在團隊目標之後。

ex.en: This issue is subordinate to the main problem.
ex.zh: 這個問題比主要問題次要。

subordinate.en: less important than something else, or under the control of it

ex.en: What subject do you think he is interested in?
ex.zh: 你覺得他會對什麼主題感興趣？

ex.en: I avoid discussing personal subjects with my boss.
ex.zh: 我避免跟老闆討論個人話題。

subject.en: the thing that is being talked about, written about or discussed

ex.en: The first subject that attracted my attention was philosophy.
ex.zh: 第一個吸引我注意的科目是哲學。

ex.en: He won the prize for excellence in all subjects.
ex.zh: 他因為各科成績優異而得獎。

subject.en: an area of knowledge that is studied at school or university

ex.en: Please write a clear subject line for your email.
ex.zh: 請在電子郵件寫上清楚的主旨。

ex.en: The subject of the email was "Meeting Update."
ex.zh: 那封電子郵件的主旨是「會議更新」。

subject.en: the short line at the top of an email that says what it is about

subject.zh: be subject to：容易受到…；須經…

ex.en: The tomato is subject to a number of diseases.
ex.zh: 番茄容易染上很多種病害。

ex.en: All prices are subject to change.
ex.zh: 所有價格可能隨時調整。

subject.en: likely to suffer from something, or depending on something happening first

ex.en: You are supposed to arrive before nine.
ex.zh: 你應該在九點前到。

ex.en: What was I supposed to do?
ex.zh: 我當時應該怎麼做？

ex.en: The supposed shortcut took us twice as long.
ex.zh: 那條所謂的捷徑讓我們多花了一倍的時間。

ex.en: Her supposed friends did not help her.
ex.zh: 她那些所謂的朋友並沒有幫她。

ex.en: There was only one survivor of the accident.
ex.zh: 這場意外只有一名生還者。

ex.en: The survivors were taken to a nearby hospital.
ex.zh: 倖存者被送到附近的醫院。

ex.en: She is a cancer survivor who now helps others.
ex.zh: 她是癌症康復者，現在幫助其他人。

ex.en: The baby began to suck on the bottle right away.
ex.zh: 小寶寶立刻開始吸奶瓶。

ex.en: He used a straw to suck the juice from the cup.
ex.zh: 他用吸管把杯子裡的果汁吸起來。

ex.en: The machine sucks dust from the carpet very quickly.
ex.zh: 這台機器能很快把地毯上的灰塵吸走。

ex.en: Sunlight came through the window and woke me up.
ex.zh: 陽光從窗戶照進來，把我叫醒了。

ex.en: Plants need sunlight and water to grow.
ex.zh: 植物需要陽光和水才能生長。

ex.en: Don't leave the milk in direct sunlight.
ex.zh: 不要把牛奶放在陽光直射的地方。

ex.en: The war caused great suffering for many families.
ex.zh: 戰爭給許多家庭帶來巨大的痛苦。

ex.en: The medicine helped to ease her suffering.
ex.zh: 這種藥幫助減輕了她的痛苦。

ex.en: The surrounding hills are covered in green trees.
ex.zh: 周圍的山丘長滿了綠樹。

ex.en: Tourists visit the town and surrounding villages.
ex.zh: 遊客會造訪這個小鎮及周圍的村莊。

ex.en: The hotel has beautiful surroundings and a quiet garden.
ex.zh: 這家飯店周遭環境優美，還有安靜的花園。

ex.en: It takes time to get used to new surroundings.
ex.zh: 適應新環境需要一些時間。

ex.en: We usually eat supper around seven o'clock.
ex.zh: 我們通常在七點左右吃晚餐。

ex.en: Mom is cooking supper in the kitchen right now.
ex.zh: 媽媽現在正在廚房煮晚餐。

ex.en: My parents are very supportive of my decision.
ex.zh: 我的父母非常支持我的決定。

ex.en: She is a supportive friend who always listens.
ex.zh: 她是個總是願意傾聽、給予支持的朋友。

ex.en: We need a supportive environment for new students.
ex.zh: 我們需要為新生提供支持性的環境。

ex.en: Allergy sufferers should avoid the garden in spring.
ex.zh: 過敏患者春天應該避免進入花園。

ex.en: The charity helps sufferers of rare diseases.
ex.zh: 這個慈善團體幫助罹患罕見疾病的人。

ex.en: We usually visit my grandparents on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我們星期天通常會去看祖父母。

ex.en: The shop is closed on Sundays.
ex.zh: 這家店星期天不營業。

ex.en: Let's meet at the park next Sunday morning.
ex.zh: 我們下個星期天早上在公園見面吧。

ex.en: Susan grows tomatoes in her small garden.
ex.zh: 蘇珊在她的小花園裡種番茄。

ex.en: Susan gave me some useful advice about the exam.
ex.zh: 蘇珊給了我一些關於考試的實用建議。

sussex.zh: 蘇塞克斯（英格蘭南部的郡）

ex.en: Sussex is a county on the south coast of England.
ex.zh: 蘇塞克斯是英格蘭南岸的一個郡。

ex.en: We spent a relaxing weekend in the Sussex countryside.
ex.zh: 我們在蘇塞克斯的鄉間度過了一個悠閒的週末。

ex.en: Sunderland is a city in the northeast of England.
ex.zh: 森德蘭是英格蘭東北部的一座城市。

ex.en: Sunderland is located at the mouth of the River Wear.
ex.zh: 森德蘭位於威爾河的河口。

ex.en: The surviving members of the band met again after twenty years.
ex.zh: 樂團尚在世的成員二十年後再度相聚。

ex.en: Only a few surviving copies of the book remain today.
ex.zh: 這本書如今只剩少數幾本留存下來。

surviving.zh: 存活、倖存（survive 的現在分詞）

ex.en: Surviving in the desert requires plenty of water.
ex.zh: 在沙漠中生存需要大量的水。

ex.en: The plants are surviving the cold winter surprisingly well.
ex.zh: 這些植物出乎意料地撐過了寒冷的冬天。

suffolk.zh: 薩福克（英格蘭東部的一個郡）

ex.en: Suffolk is a county in the east of England.
ex.zh: 薩福克是英格蘭東部的一個郡。

ex.en: They rented a small cottage near the coast of Suffolk.
ex.zh: 他們在薩福克的海岸附近租了一間小屋。

ex.en: Can you summarise the story in two sentences?
ex.zh: 你能用兩句話概述這個故事嗎？

ex.en: The teacher asked us to summarise the chapter in our own words.
ex.zh: 老師要我們用自己的話總結這一章。

ex.en: Let me summarise what we decided at the meeting.
ex.zh: 讓我總結一下我們在會議上的決定。

ex.en: He won an award for best supporting actor.
ex.zh: 他獲得了最佳男配角獎。

ex.en: The report includes supporting evidence from three studies.
ex.zh: 這份報告附有三項研究的佐證資料。

supporting.zh: 支持；支撐（support 的現在分詞）

ex.en: Thank you for supporting me through this hard time.
ex.zh: 謝謝你在這段艱難時期支持我。

ex.en: Strong pillars are supporting the roof of the old hall.
ex.zh: 堅固的柱子撐著老禮堂的屋頂。

ex.en: We watched the sunset from the top of the hill.
ex.zh: 我們在山頂上看日落。

ex.en: The sky turns orange and pink at sunset.
ex.zh: 日落時，天空會變成橘色和粉紅色。

ex.en: They walked along the beach until sunset.
ex.zh: 他們沿著海灘一直走到日落。

ex.en: Students received supplementary materials to help them study at home.
ex.zh: 學生拿到補充教材，幫助他們在家讀書。

ex.en: She took a supplementary class to improve her writing.
ex.zh: 她另外上了一堂補充課程來加強寫作。

ex.en: The two sides made no substantive progress in the talks.
ex.zh: 雙方在會談中沒有取得實質進展。

ex.en: We need substantive evidence, not just guesses.
ex.zh: 我們需要實質的證據，而不只是猜測。

ex.en: The team showed sustained effort throughout the season.
ex.zh: 整個球季，這支隊伍持續付出努力。

ex.en: Sustained exercise is good for your heart.
ex.zh: 持續運動對心臟有益。

ex.en: The company hopes for sustained growth over the next five years.
ex.zh: 公司希望未來五年能持續成長。

sustained.zh: 遭受；承受（sustain 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: He sustained a minor injury during the game.
ex.zh: 他在比賽中受了輕傷。

ex.en: The building sustained heavy damage in the storm.
ex.zh: 這棟建築在暴風雨中受到嚴重損壞。

sustained.zh: 維持；支撐（sustain 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The family sustained itself by farming and fishing.
ex.zh: 這家人靠務農和捕魚維生。

ex.en: The bridge sustained the weight of the trucks for many years.
ex.zh: 這座橋多年來一直承受著卡車的重量。

ex.en: Sutton is the name of several towns in England.
ex.zh: 薩頓是英格蘭好幾個城鎮的名稱。

ex.en: The train to Sutton leaves from London every hour.
ex.zh: 開往薩頓的火車每小時從倫敦出發。

ex.en: Sutton is a borough in the south of London.
ex.zh: 薩頓是倫敦南部的一個行政區。

ex.en: He received a summons to appear in court.
ex.zh: 他收到了出庭的傳票。

ex.en: The mayor issued a summons for an urgent meeting.
ex.zh: 市長發出召集令，要開緊急會議。

summons.zh: 召喚；傳喚（summon 的第三人稱單數）

ex.en: The principal summons students to the office when needed.
ex.zh: 必要時，校長會把學生叫到辦公室。

ex.en: The bell summons everyone to the hall at noon.
ex.zh: 鐘聲在中午召集大家到禮堂。

ex.en: Sulphur has a strong smell like rotten eggs.
ex.zh: 硫磺有種像臭蛋一樣的強烈氣味。

ex.en: Hot springs often contain a lot of sulphur.
ex.zh: 溫泉通常含有大量的硫磺。

suspected.zh: 懷疑、猜想（suspect 的過去式）

ex.en: I suspected that she was planning a surprise party for me.
ex.zh: 我猜她正在為我籌備驚喜派對。

ex.en: The teacher suspected he had copied the answers from a friend.
ex.zh: 老師懷疑他抄了朋友的答案。

ex.en: Doctors isolated the patient because of a suspected case of measles.
ex.zh: 醫生因為疑似麻疹病例而將病人隔離。

ex.en: The suspected thief was questioned by the police for two hours.
ex.zh: 這名涉嫌的小偷被警方訊問了兩個小時。

ex.en: Her test score surpassed everyone else's in the class.
ex.zh: 她的考試成績超越了班上其他所有人。

ex.en: The movie's sales surpassed all expectations.
ex.zh: 這部電影的票房超出所有人的預期。

ex.en: Please be suitably dressed for the interview.
ex.zh: 請穿著得體地參加面試。

ex.en: The cabin was suitably quiet for a weekend of reading.
ex.zh: 這間小木屋安靜得很適合用來讀書度週末。

ex.en: A short note will suffice; you don't need to write a long letter.
ex.zh: 簡短的便條就夠了，不用寫長信。

ex.en: One bag of rice should suffice for the whole week.
ex.zh: 一包米應該就足夠吃一整週。

ex.en: The singer became a superstar after her first album.
ex.zh: 這位歌手在第一張專輯之後就成了超級巨星。

ex.en: Fans waited for hours to see the football superstar.
ex.zh: 球迷等了好幾個小時，只為見那位足球超級巨星。

ex.en: I always wear sunglasses when I drive in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 我下午開車時總是戴太陽眼鏡。

ex.en: He left his sunglasses on the beach.
ex.zh: 他把太陽眼鏡忘在海灘上了。

ex.en: A subcommittee was formed to review the budget.
ex.zh: 成立了一個小組委員會來審查預算。

ex.en: The subcommittee will report its findings next week.
ex.zh: 小組委員會將於下週提出調查結果。

ex.en: We got up early to watch the sunrise from the mountain.
ex.zh: 我們一大早起床，在山上看日出。

ex.en: The sky turns pink and orange at sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出時天空會變成粉紅色和橘色。

ex.en: The player was suspended for two games after the fight.
ex.zh: 那名球員因為鬥毆被禁賽兩場。

ex.en: Train service has been suspended because of the storm.
ex.zh: 因為暴風雨，列車服務已暫停。

ex.en: A small lamp was suspended from the ceiling.
ex.zh: 一盞小燈從天花板上垂吊下來。

ex.en: Tiny dust particles stayed suspended in the sunlight.
ex.zh: 細小的灰塵懸浮在陽光中。

ex.en: He finally succumbed to the temptation and ate the cake.
ex.zh: 他終於抵擋不住誘惑，吃掉了那塊蛋糕。

ex.en: The company refused to succumb to pressure from competitors.
ex.zh: 這家公司拒絕向競爭對手的壓力低頭。

ex.en: Many patients succumbed to the disease in those years.
ex.zh: 那幾年有許多病人死於這種疾病。

ex.en: The old tree finally succumbed to the strong winds.
ex.zh: 那棵老樹終於敵不過強風而倒下。

ex.en: The subdivision of the land took several months.
ex.zh: 這塊土地的分割花了好幾個月。

ex.en: They bought a house in a new subdivision outside the city.
ex.zh: 他們在市郊一個新的住宅區買了房子。

ex.en: If I had a superpower, I would choose to fly.
ex.zh: 如果我有超能力，我會選擇飛行。

ex.en: The kids argued about whose superpower was the coolest.
ex.zh: 孩子們爭論誰的超能力最酷。

ex.en: The country became a global superpower after the war.
ex.zh: 這個國家在戰後成為全球超級強國。

ex.en: Two superpowers competed for influence for many decades.
ex.zh: 兩個超級強國競爭影響力長達數十年。

ex.en: He loves reading stories about supernatural creatures.
ex.zh: 他喜歡讀關於超自然生物的故事。

ex.en: Some people believe the old house has supernatural powers.
ex.zh: 有些人相信那棟老房子有超自然的力量。

ex.en: The film mixes a crime story with supernatural events.
ex.zh: 這部電影把犯罪故事和超自然事件結合在一起。

ex.en: Digital cameras have largely superseded film cameras.
ex.zh: 數位相機已大幅取代了底片相機。

ex.en: The new rules will supersede the old ones next month.
ex.zh: 新規定下個月起將取代舊規定。

suggested.zh: 建議；提議（suggest 的過去式）

ex.en: She suggested that we meet at the station.
ex.zh: 她建議我們在車站碰面。

ex.en: He suggested a different route to avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 他提議走另一條路以避開塞車。

suggested.zh: 暗示；顯示（suggest 的過去式）

ex.en: The results suggested that the medicine was working.
ex.zh: 結果顯示這種藥有效。

ex.en: His silence suggested that he disagreed.
ex.zh: 他的沉默暗示他並不同意。

ex.en: The suggested price for the book is twenty dollars.
ex.zh: 這本書的建議售價是二十美元。

ex.en: Follow the suggested steps on the card to set it up.
ex.zh: 請依照卡片上建議的步驟進行設定。

ex.en: We waited for the storm to subside before going outside.
ex.zh: 我們等暴風雨平息後才出門。

ex.en: The pain slowly subsided after he took the medicine.
ex.zh: 他吃了藥後，疼痛慢慢減退了。

ex.en: The flood waters began to subside on Tuesday.
ex.zh: 洪水在週二開始退去。

ex.en: The government's suppression of the protests was widely criticized.
ex.zh: 政府對抗議活動的鎮壓受到廣泛批評。

ex.en: This medicine helps with the suppression of coughing.
ex.zh: 這種藥有助於抑制咳嗽。

ex.en: The coach acted as a surrogate father for the young player.
ex.zh: 教練對那位年輕球員來說就像代理父親。

ex.en: Honey can be a surrogate for sugar in this recipe.
ex.zh: 在這道食譜裡，蜂蜜可以替代糖。

ex.en: Many families in the village live at the level of subsistence.
ex.zh: 村裡有許多家庭僅能勉強維生。

ex.en: The farmers grow just enough rice for their own subsistence.
ex.zh: 農民只種夠自己維生的稻米。

ex.en: Sudan is a country in northeastern Africa.
ex.zh: 蘇丹是非洲東北部的一個國家。

ex.en: The Nile River flows through Sudan.
ex.zh: 尼羅河流經蘇丹。

ex.en: Please write your surname in capital letters.
ex.zh: 請用大寫字母寫下你的姓氏。

ex.en: In Taiwan, the surname usually comes before the given name.
ex.zh: 在台灣，姓氏通常放在名字前面。

ex.en: Sulfur has a strong smell like rotten eggs.
ex.zh: 硫磺有一股像臭蛋的強烈氣味。

ex.en: The hot spring water contains a lot of sulfur.
ex.zh: 這處溫泉水含有大量的硫磺。

ex.en: The color of the wall changes subtly during the day.
ex.zh: 牆壁的顏色在一天中會微妙地變化。

ex.en: He subtly changed the subject to avoid an argument.
ex.zh: 他不著痕跡地轉移話題以避免爭吵。

ex.en: He was unusually subdued at dinner after the bad news.
ex.zh: 聽到壞消息後，他在晚餐時異常沉默。

ex.en: The crowd was subdued as the team left the field.
ex.zh: 球隊離場時，群眾一片低迷。

ex.en: The restaurant had subdued lighting and quiet music.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳燈光柔和，音樂輕柔。

ex.en: She chose subdued colors for the living room.
ex.zh: 她為客廳選了低調柔和的顏色。

subdued.zh: 制伏；壓抑（subdue 的過去式／過去分詞）

ex.en: The police subdued the man and took him away.
ex.zh: 警察制伏了那名男子並將他帶走。

ex.en: She subdued her anger and spoke calmly.
ex.zh: 她壓下怒氣，平靜地說話。

ex.en: A supernova can shine brighter than a whole galaxy.
ex.zh: 超新星的亮度可以超過整個星系。

ex.en: Astronomers saw a supernova in a distant galaxy.
ex.zh: 天文學家在遙遠的星系中看到一顆超新星。

ex.en: The subtlety of her humor is easy to miss.
ex.zh: 她幽默的微妙之處很容易被忽略。

ex.en: He explained the subtleties of the language to us.
ex.zh: 他向我們解釋這個語言的細微差異。

ex.en: Negotiation requires patience and subtlety.
ex.zh: 談判需要耐心和細膩的手腕。

ex.en: The empire fought for naval supremacy over the sea.
ex.zh: 那個帝國為了爭奪海上霸權而交戰。

ex.en: The company's supremacy in the market is being challenged.
ex.zh: 那家公司在市場上的領先地位正受到挑戰。

ex.en: We checked the suitability of the room for a large meeting.
ex.zh: 我們確認了這間房間是否適合開大型會議。

ex.en: The test measures a candidate's suitability for the job.
ex.zh: 這項測驗評估應徵者是否適任這份工作。

ex.en: Don't be a sucker; check the price first.
ex.zh: 別當冤大頭，先確認價格。

ex.en: He felt like a sucker after paying twice the normal fare.
ex.zh: 付了兩倍的車資後，他覺得自己像個傻瓜。

sucker.zh: 對…毫無抵抗力的人（a sucker for）

ex.en: I'm a sucker for old movies.
ex.zh: 我對老電影毫無抵抗力。

ex.en: She is a sucker for anything with chocolate.
ex.zh: 只要是巧克力做的東西，她都無法抗拒。

ex.en: An octopus has rows of suckers on its arms.
ex.zh: 章魚的腕上有一排排吸盤。

ex.en: Stick the hook to the wall with a sucker.
ex.zh: 用吸盤把掛勾黏在牆上。

ex.en: The pianist played superbly last night.
ex.zh: 那位鋼琴家昨晚的演奏精彩絕倫。

ex.en: The team performed superbly under pressure.
ex.zh: 這支團隊在壓力下表現得非常出色。

ex.en: The man looked around suspiciously before entering the building.
ex.zh: 那個男人進入大樓前，鬼鬼祟祟地四處張望。

ex.en: She eyed the strange package suspiciously.
ex.zh: 她狐疑地打量那個奇怪的包裹。

ex.en: The government will subsidise the cost of electric buses.
ex.zh: 政府將補助電動公車的成本。

ex.en: Parents often subsidise their children's rent while they study.
ex.zh: 孩子求學期間，父母常常會補貼他們的房租。

ex.en: You may need supplemental materials for the course.
ex.zh: 這門課你可能需要補充教材。

ex.en: The company offers supplemental insurance for extra costs.
ex.zh: 公司提供補充保險來負擔額外費用。

ex.en: The view from the mountain top was truly sublime.
ex.zh: 從山頂望出去的景色真是壯麗絕倫。

ex.en: She played the piece with sublime skill.
ex.zh: 她以絕妙的技巧演奏了這首曲子。

ex.en: The painter moved from the ridiculous to the sublime in a single exhibition.
ex.zh: 這位畫家在同一場展覽中從荒謬一路走到崇高。

ex.en: Poets have long written about the sublime in nature.
ex.zh: 詩人長久以來都在書寫自然中的崇高。

ex.en: Walking through the empty city at night felt surreal.
ex.zh: 夜裡走過空蕩蕩的城市，感覺很不真實。

ex.en: The painter is famous for his surreal landscapes.
ex.zh: 這位畫家以超現實的風景畫聞名。

ex.en: The class was divided into three subgroups.
ex.zh: 班上被分成三個小組。

ex.en: Each subgroup studied a different part of the problem.
ex.zh: 每個小組研究問題的不同部分。

ex.en: The shape of the cloud was suggestive of a dragon.
ex.zh: 那朵雲的形狀讓人聯想到一條龍。

ex.en: His smile was suggestive of a secret he wasn't ready to share.
ex.zh: 他的笑容暗示著他還不想說的祕密。

ex.en: The teacher asked him to stop making suggestive jokes in class.
ex.zh: 老師要他別再在課堂上開帶有性暗示的玩笑。

ex.en: The film was rated for adults because of its suggestive scenes.
ex.zh: 這部電影因為有挑逗的場景而被列為成人級。

ex.en: Women won suffrage in many countries during the twentieth century.
ex.zh: 女性在二十世紀於許多國家爭取到了選舉權。

ex.en: Universal suffrage means every adult citizen can vote.
ex.zh: 普選權意指每位成年公民都能投票。

ex.en: Judging art involves a lot of subjectivity.
ex.zh: 評斷藝術含有很多主觀成分。

ex.en: The reporter tried to avoid subjectivity in her article.
ex.zh: 記者努力在文章中避免主觀性。

ex.en: Copper sulphate forms bright blue crystals.
ex.zh: 硫酸銅會形成亮藍色的晶體。

ex.en: The farmer added sulphate to the soil.
ex.zh: 農夫在土壤中加了硫酸鹽。

ex.en: The witness received a subpoena to appear in court.
ex.zh: 證人收到了出庭的傳票。

ex.en: The lawyer served a subpoena to the company.
ex.zh: 律師向那家公司送達了傳票。

ex.en: The court subpoenaed several witnesses.
ex.zh: 法院傳喚了幾位證人。

ex.en: They plan to subpoena the company's records.
ex.zh: 他們打算傳喚該公司的紀錄。

ex.en: Submerge the vegetables in cold water for ten minutes.
ex.zh: 把蔬菜浸在冷水中十分鐘。

ex.en: The heavy rain submerged several roads in the town.
ex.zh: 大雨淹沒了鎮上好幾條道路。

ex.en: The submarine slowly submerged beneath the waves.
ex.zh: 潛水艇慢慢潛入海浪之下。

ex.en: The duck submerged for a moment and came up with a fish.
ex.zh: 那隻鴨子潛入水中一會兒，叼著一條魚浮了上來。

ex.en: The two plans look superficially similar, but they are very different.
ex.zh: 這兩個計畫表面上看起來很像，其實差很多。

ex.en: He only superficially understood the problem.
ex.zh: 他對這個問題只有粗淺的理解。

ex.en: The government banned the book as subversive.
ex.zh: 政府以具顛覆性為由禁了這本書。

ex.en: Her subversive humor challenged old ideas.
ex.zh: 她具顛覆性的幽默挑戰了舊觀念。

ex.en: The regime arrested him as a subversive.
ex.zh: 政權把他當作顛覆分子逮捕。

ex.en: Authorities watched the suspected subversives closely.
ex.zh: 當局嚴密監視那些被懷疑的顛覆分子。

ex.en: You need evidence to substantiate your claim.
ex.zh: 你需要證據來證實你的說法。

ex.en: Nothing in the report substantiates the rumor.
ex.zh: 報告中沒有任何內容能證實那則謠言。

ex.en: The group tried to subvert the government through lies.
ex.zh: 這個團體試圖用謊言顛覆政府。

ex.en: Cheating subverts the whole idea of a fair test.
ex.zh: 作弊破壞了公平考試的整個意義。

ex.en: We ordered a large plate of sushi for lunch.
ex.zh: 我們午餐點了一大盤壽司。

ex.en: She learned how to make sushi at home.
ex.zh: 她學會了在家做壽司。

ex.en: The surfer waited patiently for the perfect wave.
ex.zh: 衝浪者耐心等待完美的浪頭。

ex.en: A young surfer paddled out past the rocks.
ex.zh: 一位年輕的衝浪者划過岩石向外海去。

ex.en: The book has a long subtitle under the main title.
ex.zh: 這本書在主標題下有一個很長的副標題。

ex.en: I watch the movie with English subtitles to learn new words.
ex.zh: 我看有英文字幕的電影來學新單字。

ex.en: The artist will superimpose a map over the old photo.
ex.zh: 藝術家會把地圖疊放在舊照片上。

ex.en: You can superimpose the two images to see the difference.
ex.zh: 你可以把兩張圖像疊在一起來看差異。

succeeding.zh: 成功；接續（succeed 的現在分詞）

ex.en: She is succeeding in her new job.
ex.zh: 她在新工作上做得很成功。

ex.en: He is succeeding his father as head of the company.
ex.zh: 他正接替父親擔任公司負責人。

ex.en: The succeeding chapters explain how it works.
ex.zh: 接下來的章節說明它如何運作。

ex.en: Prices rose in the succeeding years.
ex.zh: 在隨後的幾年中物價上漲。

ex.en: She had to surmount many obstacles to finish school.
ex.zh: 她得克服許多困難才完成學業。

ex.en: The team surmounted the problem by working together.
ex.zh: 團隊靠合作克服了問題。

ex.en: In the summertime, we often swim in the river.
ex.zh: 夏天時，我們常在河裡游泳。

ex.en: Summertime is the busiest season for the beach town.
ex.zh: 夏季是這座海邊小鎮最忙碌的季節。

ex.en: The movie kept us in suspense until the very last scene.
ex.zh: 這部電影讓我們一直緊張到最後一幕。

ex.en: Please don't keep me in suspense; tell me the result now.
ex.zh: 別讓我懸著了，現在就告訴我結果吧。

ex.en: The writer is famous for her novels full of suspense.
ex.zh: 這位作家以充滿懸疑的小說聞名。

ex.en: Smartphones have largely supplanted traditional cameras.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機已大幅取代傳統相機。

ex.en: He worked hard to supplant his boss as head of the department.
ex.zh: 他努力想取代老闆成為部門主管。

ex.en: Divers explored a sunken ship at the bottom of the sea.
ex.zh: 潛水員探索了海底一艘沉沒的船。

ex.en: The old man had sunken cheeks and tired eyes.
ex.zh: 那位老人臉頰凹陷，眼神疲憊。

ex.en: They built a sunken garden below the level of the street.
ex.zh: 他們在低於街面的地方蓋了一座下沉式花園。

ex.en: Supposing it rains tomorrow, what will we do?
ex.zh: 假如明天下雨，我們要怎麼辦？

ex.en: Supposing you lost your keys, who would have a spare?
ex.zh: 萬一你把鑰匙弄丟了，誰有備用的？

ex.en: The sunflower turns its head to follow the sun.
ex.zh: 向日葵會轉動花盤追隨太陽。

ex.en: We walked through a field of tall yellow sunflowers.
ex.zh: 我們走過一片高高的黃色向日葵花田。

ex.en: Sunflower oil is often used for cooking.
ex.zh: 葵花油常被用來烹飪。

ex.en: The princess had many suitors, but she chose none.
ex.zh: 公主有許多追求者，但她一個也沒選。

ex.en: In the novel, a rich suitor visits her every week.
ex.zh: 小說裡，一位富有的追求者每週都來拜訪她。

suez.zh: 蘇伊士（埃及的運河與城市）

ex.en: The Suez Canal connects the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea.
ex.zh: 蘇伊士運河連接地中海與紅海。

ex.en: Many cargo ships pass through Suez every day.
ex.zh: 每天有許多貨輪經過蘇伊士。

ex.en: She bought a pair of brown suede boots.
ex.zh: 她買了一雙棕色麂皮靴。

ex.en: Suede is soft but easily stained by water.
ex.zh: 麂皮很柔軟，但容易被水弄髒。

ex.en: Suzanne is a given name used in English and French.
ex.zh: 蘇珊娜是英語和法語中使用的女子名。

ex.en: My cousin Suzanne is coming to visit next week.
ex.zh: 我的表姊蘇珊娜下週要來玩。

ex.en: Skateboarding grew into a subculture with its own music and style.
ex.zh: 滑板發展成有自己音樂和風格的次文化。

ex.en: She wrote a paper on an online gaming subculture.
ex.zh: 她寫了一篇關於網路遊戲次文化的報告。

ex.en: The sullen boy sat in the corner and refused to speak.
ex.zh: 那個悶悶不樂的男孩坐在角落，不肯說話。

ex.en: She gave a sullen reply and left the room.
ex.zh: 她陰沉地回了一句就離開了房間。

sultan.zh: 蘇丹（某些伊斯蘭國家君主的稱號）

ex.en: The sultan ruled the empire from his grand palace.
ex.zh: 蘇丹在宏偉的宮殿裡統治著帝國。

ex.en: Stories about a generous sultan are told in many old tales.
ex.zh: 許多古老故事都在講一位慷慨的蘇丹。

ex.en: The workers resented their subordination to the new manager.
ex.zh: 工人們對於要從屬於新經理感到不滿。

ex.en: The subordination of personal wishes to the team's goals is sometimes necessary.
ex.zh: 有時必須讓個人意願服從團隊的目標。

ex.en: Subsidence damaged several houses near the old mine.
ex.zh: 地層下陷損壞了舊礦場附近的幾棟房屋。

ex.en: The city is studying the subsidence of the ground.
ex.zh: 這座城市正在研究地面的下陷。

ex.en: He acted as surety for his brother's loan.
ex.zh: 他為弟弟的貸款擔任保證人。

ex.en: The court asked for a surety before releasing her.
ex.zh: 法院要求提供擔保才會放她出去。

subsidized.zh: 補貼、資助（subsidize 的過去式）

ex.en: The government subsidized the cost of solar panels.
ex.zh: 政府補貼了太陽能板的費用。

ex.en: The city subsidized public transport for students.
ex.zh: 市政府補助學生的大眾運輸費用。

ex.en: I surmise that he missed the bus again.
ex.zh: 我猜他又錯過公車了。

ex.en: From the footprints, we surmised that someone had been here.
ex.zh: 從腳印我們推測有人來過這裡。

ex.en: His surmise turned out to be correct.
ex.zh: 他的推測最後證明是對的。

ex.en: This is only a surmise, so we need more proof.
ex.zh: 這只是個猜測，我們還需要更多證據。

ex.en: Delete any superfluous words from your essay.
ex.zh: 把文章裡多餘的字刪掉。

ex.en: The extra instructions were superfluous, since everyone already knew what to do.
ex.zh: 那些額外的說明是多餘的，因為大家本來就知道該怎麼做。

ex.en: The Sudanese city lies beside the Nile.
ex.zh: 那座蘇丹城市就位在尼羅河畔。

ex.en: She cooked a traditional Sudanese meal for her friends.
ex.zh: 她為朋友做了一頓傳統的蘇丹料理。

ex.en: The doctor is a Sudanese who studied in Egypt.
ex.zh: 這位醫生是在埃及求學的蘇丹人。

ex.en: Many Sudanese live in the capital, Khartoum.
ex.zh: 許多蘇丹人住在首都喀土穆。

ex.en: Please explain the problem as succinctly as possible.
ex.zh: 請盡可能簡潔地說明這個問題。

ex.en: The author succinctly sums up the story in one paragraph.
ex.zh: 作者用一段話簡潔地總結了這個故事。

susceptibility.zh: 易受影響的特性；敏感性

ex.en: Older people have a greater susceptibility to the flu.
ex.zh: 年長者較容易感染流感。

ex.en: The test measures a person's susceptibility to stress.
ex.zh: 這項測驗評估一個人對壓力的敏感程度。

ex.en: The drawer was full of sundry items like tape and string.
ex.zh: 抽屜裡裝滿了膠帶、繩子等雜七雜八的東西。

ex.en: He sold sundry goods at a small roadside stand.
ex.zh: 他在路邊的小攤販賣各種雜貨。

ex.en: We enjoyed a sumptuous dinner at the hotel.
ex.zh: 我們在飯店享用了一頓豐盛的晚餐。

ex.en: The palace was decorated in sumptuous style.
ex.zh: 宮殿以奢華的風格裝飾。

ex.en: The soldiers had little sustenance for days.
ex.zh: 士兵們好幾天都沒什麼東西可吃。

ex.en: A bowl of soup provided warmth and sustenance.
ex.zh: 一碗湯帶來了溫暖與養分。

ex.en: The leather was soft and supple.
ex.zh: 這塊皮革柔軟又有彈性。

ex.en: Dancers need supple muscles.
ex.zh: 舞者需要柔軟靈活的肌肉。

ex.en: The city has a subterranean railway system.
ex.zh: 這座城市有地下鐵路系統。

ex.en: They explored a subterranean cave.
ex.zh: 他們探索了一個地下洞穴。

ex.en: He wore dark sunglasses on the bright beach.
ex.zh: 在明亮的海灘上，他戴著深色太陽眼鏡。

ex.en: I left my sunglasses in the car.
ex.zh: 我把太陽眼鏡留在車上了。

ex.en: That is only a supposition, and we have no proof yet.
ex.zh: 那只是推測，我們還沒有證據。

ex.en: His plan was based on the supposition that prices would stay low.
ex.zh: 他的計畫是建立在價格會維持低檔的假設上。

ex.en: This category subsumes several smaller groups of animals.
ex.zh: 這個類別涵蓋了幾個較小的動物群體。

ex.en: Small projects were subsumed under one large program.
ex.zh: 幾個小型計畫被併入一個大型計畫之下。

ex.en: The farmer plans to subdivide the land into small plots.
ex.zh: 農夫打算把土地再細分成小塊。

ex.en: The teacher subdivided the class into groups of four.
ex.zh: 老師把全班再分成四人一組。

subsidised.zh: 資助；補助（subsidise 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The government subsidised the cost of school lunches.
ex.zh: 政府補助了學校午餐的費用。

ex.en: Local farmers were subsidised during the dry season.
ex.zh: 乾旱季節期間，當地農民獲得了補助。

ex.en: She was supremely confident before the final exam.
ex.zh: 期末考前她信心十足。

ex.en: The chef is supremely talented and cooks every dish perfectly.
ex.zh: 那位主廚才華出眾，每道菜都做得完美。

ex.en: A submerged rock damaged the bottom of the boat.
ex.zh: 一塊沉在水下的岩石撞壞了船底。

ex.en: After the flood, many streets were submerged for days.
ex.zh: 洪水過後，許多街道被淹沒了好幾天。

ex.en: She spoke with suppressed anger in her voice.
ex.zh: 她說話時聲音裡壓抑著怒氣。

ex.en: The students let out a suppressed laugh in class.
ex.zh: 學生們在課堂上忍著笑了一聲。

ex.en: The vacuum cleaner has strong suction.
ex.zh: 這台吸塵器的吸力很強。

ex.en: The suction cup holds the phone on the car window.
ex.zh: 吸盤把手機固定在車窗上。

ex.en: The team won three games successively.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍連續贏了三場比賽。

ex.en: Prices rose successively over the past five months.
ex.zh: 過去五個月物價接連上漲。

ex.en: He went to his room to sulk after losing the game.
ex.zh: 他輸了比賽後回房間生悶氣。

ex.en: Stop sulking and tell me what is bothering you.
ex.zh: 別再悶不吭聲了，告訴我你在煩什麼。

ex.en: She is in a sulk because we forgot her birthday.
ex.zh: 她因為我們忘了她的生日而在鬧脾氣。

ex.en: He had a sulk for an hour and then felt better.
ex.zh: 他悶悶不樂了一個小時，後來就好多了。

ex.en: The ship's superstructure was painted white.
ex.zh: 那艘船的上層結構漆成白色。

ex.en: Workers finished the bridge's superstructure this spring.
ex.zh: 工人今年春天完成了橋的上部結構。

ex.en: It was a sultry summer afternoon with no wind.
ex.zh: 那是個沒有風、悶熱的夏日午後。

ex.en: The sultry weather made everyone tired and sleepy.
ex.zh: 悶熱的天氣讓每個人都又累又想睡。

ex.en: The singer has a sultry voice that fills the room.
ex.zh: 那位歌手有著迷人低沉的嗓音，迴盪在整個房間。

ex.en: She gave him a sultry smile across the table.
ex.zh: 她隔著桌子對他投以迷人的微笑。

ex.en: The old government was afraid of subversion from within.
ex.zh: 舊政府害怕來自內部的顛覆。

ex.en: The spy was accused of subversion and put on trial.
ex.zh: 那名間諜被指控從事顛覆活動而受審。

ex.en: Dreams may come from deep in the subconscious.
ex.zh: 夢可能來自潛意識的深處。

ex.en: The song stayed in her subconscious for years.
ex.zh: 那首歌在她的潛意識裡留了好多年。

ex.en: He made a subconscious effort to avoid eye contact.
ex.zh: 他下意識地避免眼神接觸。

ex.en: She had a subconscious fear of deep water.
ex.zh: 她潛意識裡害怕深水。

ex.en: We reached the cabin just before sundown.
ex.zh: 我們在日落前剛好抵達小屋。

ex.en: The farmers worked from sunrise to sundown.
ex.zh: 農夫從日出工作到日落。

ex.en: Each subsystem of the machine is tested separately.
ex.zh: 這台機器的每個子系統都會分開測試。

ex.en: A failure in the cooling subsystem caused the server to shut down.
ex.zh: 散熱子系統發生故障，導致伺服器關機。

ex.en: The film's subtext is about the cost of ambition.
ex.zh: 這部電影的潛臺詞是在談野心的代價。

ex.en: I could sense an angry subtext in her polite words.
ex.zh: 我能從她客氣的話語中感覺到憤怒的弦外之音。

surgically.zh: 以外科手術方式；精準地

ex.en: The tumor was removed surgically last week.
ex.zh: 腫瘤上星期以外科手術切除了。

ex.en: She edited the report surgically, cutting only what was unnecessary.
ex.zh: 她精準地修改報告，只刪掉不必要的部分。

ex.en: I got a bad sunburn at the beach.
ex.zh: 我在海邊被曬得很嚴重。

ex.en: Aloe gel can soothe a painful sunburn.
ex.zh: 蘆薈膠可以舒緩疼痛的曬傷。

ex.en: Fair skin can sunburn in just ten minutes.
ex.zh: 白皙的皮膚只要十分鐘就可能曬傷。

ex.en: Be sure to wear a hat so you don't sunburn.
ex.zh: 記得戴帽子，才不會曬傷。

sumatra.zh: 蘇門答臘島（印尼西部的大島）

ex.en: Sumatra is a large island in western Indonesia.
ex.zh: 蘇門答臘是印尼西部的一座大島。

ex.en: Tigers and orangutans live in the forests of Sumatra.
ex.zh: 老虎和紅毛猩猩棲息在蘇門答臘的森林中。

ex.en: The inspectors found substandard materials in the building.
ex.zh: 檢查人員在這棟建築裡發現不合標準的材料。

ex.en: Customers complained about the substandard service.
ex.zh: 顧客抱怨服務品質不佳。

ex.en: The suffix -ness turns an adjective into a noun.
ex.zh: 字尾 -ness 能把形容詞變成名詞。

ex.en: Add the suffix -ly to make an adverb.
ex.zh: 加上字尾 -ly 就能變成副詞。

ex.en: You can suffix this word with -ing to form a verb.
ex.zh: 你可以在這個字後面加 -ing 變成動詞形式。

ex.en: The programmer suffixed each file name with the date.
ex.zh: 程式設計師在每個檔名後面加上日期。

ex.en: We had breakfast in a sunlit kitchen.
ex.zh: 我們在陽光灑落的廚房裡吃早餐。

ex.en: A sunlit path led through the meadow.
ex.zh: 一條灑滿陽光的小路穿過草地。

ex.en: He surreptitiously checked his phone during the meeting.
ex.zh: 他在會議中偷偷看手機。

ex.en: She surreptitiously slipped a note into his bag.
ex.zh: 她偷偷把一張紙條塞進他的包包裡。

ex.en: Sugarcane grows best in warm, wet climates.
ex.zh: 甘蔗最適合在溫暖潮濕的氣候中生長。

ex.en: We drank fresh sugarcane juice at the night market.
ex.zh: 我們在夜市喝了現榨的甘蔗汁。

ex.en: Warm light suffused the room at sunset.
ex.zh: 日落時分，溫暖的光線灑滿了整個房間。

ex.en: The kitchen was suffused with the smell of fresh bread.
ex.zh: 廚房裡瀰漫著剛出爐麵包的香味。

ex.en: The speaker condemned the supremacist views of the group.
ex.zh: 演講者譴責了該團體的至上主義觀點。

ex.en: Websites that spread supremacist ideas were removed.
ex.zh: 散播至上主義思想的網站已被移除。

ex.en: The surly waiter barely looked at us.
ex.zh: 那位態度惡劣的服務生幾乎沒正眼看我們。

ex.en: He gave a surly reply and walked away.
ex.zh: 他不客氣地回了一句就走開了。

ex.en: Many families subsist on less than two dollars a day.
ex.zh: 許多家庭靠每天不到兩美元勉強維生。

ex.en: The villagers subsisted mainly on rice and fish.
ex.zh: 村民主要靠米飯和魚維生。

ex.en: Some animals can subsist for weeks without water.
ex.zh: 有些動物可以好幾週不喝水而存活。

ex.en: The jet can fly at supersonic speeds.
ex.zh: 這架噴射機能以超音速飛行。

ex.en: A supersonic plane crosses the ocean much faster.
ex.zh: 超音速飛機橫越大洋快得多。

ex.en: Iron sulphide is a compound of iron and sulphur.
ex.zh: 硫化鐵是鐵和硫的化合物。

ex.en: The smell of rotten eggs comes from hydrogen sulphide.
ex.zh: 臭蛋的味道來自硫化氫。

ex.en: My little brother dressed up as a superhero for Halloween.
ex.zh: 我弟弟萬聖節時打扮成超級英雄。

ex.en: The superhero saved the city in the last scene of the movie.
ex.zh: 超級英雄在電影最後一幕拯救了城市。

ex.en: He sat by the fire and supped his hot tea.
ex.zh: 他坐在爐火旁啜飲熱茶。

ex.en: They supped together on bread and soup.
ex.zh: 他們一起用麵包和湯吃了晚餐。

ex.en: She took a small sup of the soup to test it.
ex.zh: 她喝了一小口湯試味道。

ex.en: He wanted just a sup of water before bed.
ex.zh: 他睡前只想喝一小口水。

ex.en: She became a supermodel at the age of twenty.
ex.zh: 她二十歲就成為超級名模。

ex.en: The magazine cover featured a famous supermodel.
ex.zh: 雜誌封面是一位知名的超級名模。

ex.en: Don't sully your good name by lying.
ex.zh: 別因為說謊而玷汙了你的名聲。

ex.en: The scandal sullied the company's reputation.
ex.zh: 那樁醜聞玷汙了公司的名譽。

ex.en: Mud sullied his clean white shirt.
ex.zh: 泥巴弄髒了他乾淨的白襯衫。

ex.en: Vitamin D supplementation is common in countries with little sunshine.
ex.zh: 在日照少的國家，補充維生素D很常見。

ex.en: The doctor recommended iron supplementation for her tiredness.
ex.zh: 醫生建議她補充鐵質來改善疲勞。

ex.en: The school's budget needed supplementation from donations.
ex.zh: 學校的預算需要靠捐款來補足。

ex.en: The summation of these numbers is one hundred.
ex.zh: 這些數字的總和是一百。

ex.en: Summation is the process of adding numbers together.
ex.zh: 加總就是把數字加在一起的過程。

ex.en: The lawyer ended with a clear summation of the case.
ex.zh: 律師以對案件的清楚總結作為結尾。

ex.en: In summation, the plan was cheap and easy to carry out.
ex.zh: 總而言之，這個計畫便宜又容易執行。

ex.en: The dog rolled over in a submissive way.
ex.zh: 那隻狗用順從的姿勢翻過身去。

ex.en: He was too submissive to argue with his boss.
ex.zh: 他太順從了，不敢和老闆爭論。

ex.en: She refused to be a submissive wife in the story.
ex.zh: 在故事裡，她拒絕當一個順從的妻子。

ex.en: They moved out of the city and settled in quiet suburbia.
ex.zh: 他們搬離市區，在安靜的郊區定居。

ex.en: Life in suburbia often means a bigger yard and a longer commute.
ex.zh: 郊區生活通常代表院子比較大，通勤時間比較長。

ex.en: Freud said the superego acts like a moral conscience.
ex.zh: 佛洛伊德認為超我像是一種道德良知。

ex.en: His strong superego made him feel guilty about small mistakes.
ex.zh: 他強烈的超我讓他對小錯誤也感到內疚。

ex.en: Lifting the car took superhuman strength.
ex.zh: 把車子抬起來需要超乎常人的力氣。

ex.en: The nurses made a superhuman effort during the long night.
ex.zh: 護理師們在漫漫長夜裡付出了超乎常人的努力。

ex.en: She subconsciously touched her hair whenever she was nervous.
ex.zh: 她一緊張就會下意識地摸頭髮。

ex.en: He subconsciously chose the same seat every day.
ex.zh: 他不自覺地每天都選同一個座位。

ex.en: The superhighway connects the two big cities.
ex.zh: 這條高速公路連接了兩座大城市。

ex.en: We drove for hours on a busy superhighway.
ex.zh: 我們在車多的高速公路上開了好幾個小時。

ex.en: He wore suspenders to hold up his trousers.
ex.zh: 他穿吊帶來固定長褲。

ex.en: My grandfather always wore a shirt with suspenders.
ex.zh: 我祖父總是穿襯衫配吊帶。

ex.en: Try not to drink too many sugary drinks.
ex.zh: 盡量別喝太多含糖飲料。

ex.en: The cereal is too sugary for me.
ex.zh: 這種穀片對我來說太甜了。

ex.en: Please keep your answer short and succinct.
ex.zh: 請把你的回答保持簡短扼要。

ex.en: Her succinct summary saved everyone a lot of time.
ex.zh: 她簡潔的摘要替大家省下了很多時間。

summarily.zh: 立即地；不經正式程序地

ex.en: The student was summarily dismissed from the class for cheating.
ex.zh: 那名學生因作弊被當場逐出課堂。

ex.en: The request was summarily rejected without any discussion.
ex.zh: 這項要求未經任何討論就被直接駁回。

ex.en: Superconducting wires carry electricity with almost no loss.
ex.zh: 超導電線傳輸電力時幾乎沒有損耗。

ex.en: The hospital's MRI machine uses a superconducting magnet.
ex.zh: 這家醫院的核磁共振儀使用超導磁鐵。

ex.en: I ordered a chocolate sundae with extra nuts.
ex.zh: 我點了一份加量堅果的巧克力聖代。

ex.en: The kids shared a strawberry sundae after dinner.
ex.zh: 孩子們晚餐後分著吃了一份草莓聖代。

ex.en: The country is working toward food sufficiency.
ex.zh: 這個國家正朝糧食自給自足努力。

ex.en: The sufficiency of the evidence is still being debated.
ex.zh: 證據是否充分仍有爭論。

ex.en: Astronomers watch each sunspot with special telescopes.
ex.zh: 天文學家用特殊望遠鏡觀察每一個太陽黑子。

ex.en: A large sunspot can be seen with proper eye protection.
ex.zh: 戴上適當的護目裝備就能看到大型的太陽黑子。

ex.en: This bird is a subspecies found only on the northern coast.
ex.zh: 這種鳥是只在北岸才有的亞種。

ex.en: Scientists named a new subspecies of tiger after studying its stripes.
ex.zh: 科學家研究條紋後，為老虎命名了一個新亞種。

ex.en: This job is well suited to someone who loves people.
ex.zh: 這份工作很適合喜歡與人相處的人。

ex.en: He is not suited to working alone all day.
ex.zh: 他不適合整天一個人工作。

ex.en: The servants were expected to be quiet and subservient.
ex.zh: 僕人被要求安靜又順從。

ex.en: She refused to be subservient to her boss's every whim.
ex.zh: 她拒絕對老闆的一切怪念頭唯命是從。

ex.en: Some ads use subliminal messages to influence what you buy.
ex.zh: 有些廣告用潛意識的訊息來影響你買什麼。

ex.en: The music had a subliminal effect on how calm I felt.
ex.zh: 這段音樂在潛移默化中影響了我平靜的感覺。

ex.en: The room was hot and suffocating.
ex.zh: 房間又熱又悶得讓人喘不過氣。

ex.en: He felt the suffocating pressure of so many deadlines.
ex.zh: 他感到被這麼多截止日期壓得喘不過氣。

ex.en: The smoke was suffocating the people trapped inside.
ex.zh: 濃煙讓被困在裡面的人們窒息。

ex.en: Too many weeds are suffocating the young plants.
ex.zh: 太多雜草讓幼苗透不過氣。

suave.zh: 圓滑而有禮的；風度翩翩的

ex.en: The suave host greeted every guest by name.
ex.zh: 那位風度翩翩的主人一一叫出每位賓客的名字。

ex.en: He gave a suave reply and avoided the question.
ex.zh: 他很圓滑地回答，避開了那個問題。

ex.en: India, Pakistan and Bangladesh make up much of the Indian subcontinent.
ex.zh: 印度、巴基斯坦和孟加拉構成了印度次大陸的大部分。

ex.en: Monsoon rains are vital to the whole subcontinent.
ex.zh: 季風雨對整個次大陸都至關重要。

ex.en: Copper sulfate forms bright blue crystals.
ex.zh: 硫酸銅會形成亮藍色的結晶。

ex.en: Some shampoos say they contain no sulfate.
ex.zh: 有些洗髮精標示不含硫酸鹽。

surging.zh: 洶湧；急遽上升（surge 的現在分詞）

ex.en: Crowds were surging toward the stage when the band appeared.
ex.zh: 樂團一出場，人群就湧向舞台。

ex.en: Prices keep surging because of the shortage.
ex.zh: 因為短缺，物價持續飆升。

ex.en: Superman is a comic book hero who can fly.
ex.zh: 超人是一位會飛的漫畫英雄。

ex.en: You can't work all night every day; you're not a superman.
ex.zh: 你不能每天熬夜工作，你又不是超人。

ex.en: The suburbanite drives into the city for work every day.
ex.zh: 這位郊區居民每天開車進城上班。

ex.en: Many suburbanites enjoy having a yard for their children.
ex.zh: 許多郊區居民喜歡有個院子給孩子玩。

ex.en: Taiwan has a subtropical climate with hot, humid summers.
ex.zh: 台灣屬於亞熱帶氣候，夏天又熱又潮濕。

ex.en: Bananas grow well in subtropical regions.
ex.zh: 香蕉在亞熱帶地區長得很好。

ex.en: The history book describes the subjugation of the local tribes.
ex.zh: 這本歷史書描述了當地部落被征服的經過。

ex.en: People fought for years against the subjugation of their country.
ex.zh: 人民多年來奮力抵抗自己國家被征服。

ex.en: The new supremo of the company promised big changes.
ex.zh: 公司新的最高負責人承諾將有重大改變。

ex.en: He is the supremo in charge of the whole project.
ex.zh: 他是整個專案的總負責人。

ex.en: The empire tried to subjugate the neighboring tribes.
ex.zh: 那個帝國試圖征服鄰近的部落。

ex.en: The army subjugated the region within a year.
ex.zh: 軍隊在一年內就征服了該地區。

suss.zh: 查明、弄清楚（常用 suss out）

ex.en: I'll suss out what went wrong with the schedule.
ex.zh: 我會查清楚行程出了什麼問題。

ex.en: It took her a week to suss out how the new system worked.
ex.zh: 她花了一個星期才弄懂新系統怎麼運作。

ex.en: The people lived in subjection to a foreign ruler.
ex.zh: 人民受外國統治者支配而生活。

ex.en: The subjection of the region took many years.
ex.zh: 征服這個地區花了許多年。

submersible.zh: 可潛水的、可浸入水中的

ex.en: The scientists used a submersible vehicle to explore the sea floor.
ex.zh: 科學家使用潛水載具探索海底。

ex.en: This is a submersible pump for the garden pond.
ex.zh: 這是花園池塘用的潛水泵浦。

ex.en: The submersible dived slowly into the dark water.
ex.zh: 潛水器緩緩潛入黑暗的水中。

ex.en: The crew checked the submersible before the trip.
ex.zh: 工作人員在出發前檢查了潛水器。
